FILE: src/ObserverMagazine.Web/Services/BookNavigator.cs
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Models;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;

public static class BookNavigator
{
    public static IReadOnlyList<SubchapterLocation> Flatten(BookToc toc) =>
        toc.Chapters
            .SelectMany(chapter => chapter.Subchapters.Select(sub => new SubchapterLocation(chapter, sub)))
            .ToArray();

    public static SubchapterLocation? Find(BookToc toc, string chapterSlug, string subchapterSlug) =>
        Flatten(toc).FirstOrDefault(l =>
            string.Equals(l.Chapter.Slug, chapterSlug, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
            string.Equals(l.Subchapter.Slug, subchapterSlug, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

    public static SubchapterLocation? First(BookToc toc) => Flatten(toc).FirstOrDefault();

    public static SubchapterNeighbors GetNeighbors(BookToc toc, SubchapterLocation current)
    {
        var all = Flatten(toc);
        var index = IndexOf(all, current);
        if (index < 0)
        {
            return new SubchapterNeighbors(null, null);
        }

        return new SubchapterNeighbors(
            index > 0 ? all[index - 1] : null,
            index < all.Count - 1 ? all[index + 1] : null);
    }

    internal static int IndexOf(IReadOnlyList<SubchapterLocation> all, SubchapterLocation location)
    {
        for (var i = 0; i < all.Count; i++)
        {
            if (all[i].ProgressKey == location.ProgressKey)
            {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
}


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FILE: src/ObserverMagazine.Web/Services/BookProgressCalculator.cs
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Models;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;

public static class BookProgressCalculator
{
    public static SubchapterStatus GetStatus(SubchapterLocation location, BookProgress? progress)
    {
        var subProgress = GetSubchapterProgress(location, progress);
        if (subProgress is null || (subProgress.FirstVisitedAt is null && subProgress.Questions.Count == 0))
        {
            return SubchapterStatus.NotStarted;
        }

        return IsComplete(location.Subchapter, subProgress) ? SubchapterStatus.Completed : SubchapterStatus.InProgress;
    }

    public static bool IsComplete(SubchapterToc subchapter, SubchapterProgress? progress)
    {
        if (progress is null)
        {
            return false;
        }

        return subchapter.QuestionIds.Length == 0
            ? progress.FirstVisitedAt is not null
            : subchapter.QuestionIds.All(id => progress.Questions.TryGetValue(id, out var q) && q.AnsweredCorrectly);
    }

    public static int CountCorrect(SubchapterToc subchapter, SubchapterProgress? progress) =>
        progress is null
            ? 0
            : subchapter.QuestionIds.Count(id => progress.Questions.TryGetValue(id, out var q) && q.AnsweredCorrectly);

    public static BookCompletion GetCompletion(BookToc toc, BookProgress? progress)
    {
        var completed = 0;
        var correct = 0;
        var total = 0;
        var totalQuestions = 0;

        foreach (var location in BookNavigator.Flatten(toc))
        {
            var subProgress = GetSubchapterProgress(location, progress);
            total++;
            totalQuestions += location.Subchapter.QuestionIds.Length;
            correct += CountCorrect(location.Subchapter, subProgress);
            if (IsComplete(location.Subchapter, subProgress))
            {
                completed++;
            }
        }

        return new BookCompletion(completed, total, correct, totalQuestions);
    }

    public static SubchapterLocation? GetContinueLocation(BookToc toc, BookProgress? progress)
    {
        var all = BookNavigator.Flatten(toc);
        if (all.Count == 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var startIndex = 0;
        if (progress?.LastChapterSlug is { } chapterSlug && progress.LastSubchapterSlug is { } subSlug)
        {
            var last = BookNavigator.Find(toc, chapterSlug, subSlug);
            if (last is not null)
            {
                startIndex = BookNavigator.IndexOf(all, last);
                if (!IsComplete(last.Subchapter, GetSubchapterProgress(last, progress)))
                {
                    return last;
                }
            }
        }

        for (var offset = 0; offset < all.Count; offset++)
        {
            var candidate = all[(startIndex + offset) % all.Count];
            if (!IsComplete(candidate.Subchapter, GetSubchapterProgress(candidate, progress)))
            {
                return candidate;
            }
        }

        return all[0];
    }

    private static SubchapterProgress? GetSubchapterProgress(SubchapterLocation location, BookProgress? progress) =>
        progress?.Subchapters.GetValueOrDefault(location.ProgressKey);
}

FILE: src/ObserverMagazine.Web/Services/BookService.cs
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text.Json;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Models;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;

public sealed class BookService(HttpClient http, ILogger<BookService> logger) : IBookService
{
    public const string DataRoot = "book-data";

    private readonly Dictionary<string, BookToc> _tocCache = [with(StringComparer.Ordinal)];
    private BookSummary[]? _indexCache;

    public async Task<BookSummary[]> GetBooksAsync()
    {
        if (_indexCache is not null)
        {
            return _indexCache;
        }

        var books = await FetchAsync<BookSummary[]>($"{DataRoot}/books-index.json");
        if (books is null)
        {
            return [];
        }

        _indexCache = books.OrderByDescending(b => b.Date).ToArray();
        logger.LogInformation("Loaded {Count} books", _indexCache.Length);
        return _indexCache;
    }

    public async Task<BookSummary?> GetBookAsync(string bookSlug)
    {
        if (!ContentSlug.TryNormalize(bookSlug, out var slug))
        {
            return null;
        }

        var books = await GetBooksAsync();
        return books.FirstOrDefault(b => string.Equals(b.Slug, slug, StringComparison.Ordinal));
    }

    public async Task<BookToc?> GetTocAsync(string bookSlug)
    {
        if (!ContentSlug.TryNormalize(bookSlug, out var slug))
        {
            return null;
        }

        if (_tocCache.TryGetValue(slug, out var cached))
        {
            return cached;
        }

        var toc = await FetchAsync<BookToc>($"{DataRoot}/{slug}/toc.json");
        if (toc is not null)
        {
            _tocCache[slug] = toc;
        }
        return toc;
    }

    public async Task<SubchapterContent?> GetSubchapterAsync(string bookSlug, string chapterSlug, string subchapterSlug)
    {
        if (!ContentSlug.TryNormalize(bookSlug, out var book) ||
            !ContentSlug.TryNormalize(chapterSlug, out var chapter) ||
            !ContentSlug.TryNormalize(subchapterSlug, out var subchapter))
        {
            return null;
        }

        return await FetchAsync<SubchapterContent>($"{DataRoot}/{book}/{chapter}/{subchapter}.json");
    }

    private async Task<T?> FetchAsync<T>(string path) where T : class
    {
        try
        {
            return await http.GetFromJsonAsync<T>(path);
        }
        catch (HttpRequestException ex)
        {
            logger.LogWarning(ex, "Book data not available at {Path}", path);
        }
        catch (JsonException ex)
        {
            logger.LogError(ex, "Book data at {Path} is not valid JSON", path);
        }
        catch (NotSupportedException ex)
        {
            logger.LogError(ex, "Book data at {Path} has an unsupported content type", path);
        }
        catch (TaskCanceledException ex)
        {
            logger.LogWarning(ex, "Timed out loading book data at {Path}", path);
        }
        return null;
    }
}

FILE: src/ObserverMagazine.Web/Services/ContentSlug.cs
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;

public static partial class ContentSlug
{
    private const int MaxLength = 200;

    [GeneratedRegex("^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant)]
    private static partial Regex Pattern();

    public static bool TryNormalize(string? value, [NotNullWhen(true)] out string? slug)
    {
        slug = null;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) || value.Length > MaxLength)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var candidate = value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
        if (!Pattern().IsMatch(candidate))
        {
            return false;
        }

        slug = candidate;
        return true;
    }
}


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FILE: src/ObserverMagazine.Web/Services/FallbackProgressStore.cs
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;

public sealed class FallbackProgressStore(
    IProgressStore primary,
    IProgressStore fallback,
    ILogger<FallbackProgressStore> logger) : IProgressStore
{
    private bool _primaryFailed;

    public bool IsUsingFallback => _primaryFailed;

    public ValueTask<string?> GetAsync(string key) =>
        ExecuteAsync(store => store.GetAsync(key));

    public async ValueTask SetAsync(string key, string value) =>
        await ExecuteAsync(async store =>
        {
            await store.SetAsync(key, value);
            return true;
        });

    public async ValueTask RemoveAsync(string key) =>
        await ExecuteAsync(async store =>
        {
            await store.RemoveAsync(key);
            return true;
        });

    public ValueTask<bool> IsPersistentAsync() =>
        ExecuteAsync(store => store.IsPersistentAsync());

    private async ValueTask<T> ExecuteAsync<T>(Func<IProgressStore, ValueTask<T>> operation)
    {
        if (!_primaryFailed)
        {
            try
            {
                return await operation(primary);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _primaryFailed = true;
                logger.LogWarning(ex, "Persistent progress storage is unavailable; progress will be kept in memory for this session");
            }
        }

        return await operation(fallback);
    }
}

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;

public static class HtmlPostProcessor
{
    private const string TableWrapOpen = "<div class=\"table-scroll-wrap\"><table";

    public static string Process(string? html)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(html))
        {
            return "";
        }

        return html
            .Replace("<table", TableWrapOpen, StringComparison.Ordinal)
            .Replace("</table>", "</table></div>", StringComparison.Ordinal);
    }
}

using Microsoft.JSInterop;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;

public sealed class LocalBrowserStorage(IJSRuntime js) : IBrowserStorage
{
    public async ValueTask<string?> GetAsync(string key)
    {
        try
        {
            return await js.InvokeAsync<string?>("localStorage.getItem", key);
        }
        catch (JSException ex)
        {
            throw Unavailable(ex);
        }
    }

    public async ValueTask SetAsync(string key, string value)
    {
        try
        {
            await js.InvokeVoidAsync("localStorage.setItem", key, value);
        }
        catch (JSException ex)
        {
            throw Unavailable(ex);
        }
    }

    public async ValueTask RemoveAsync(string key)
    {
        try
        {
            await js.InvokeVoidAsync("localStorage.removeItem", key);
        }
        catch (JSException ex)
        {
            throw Unavailable(ex);
        }
    }

    private static BrowserStorageException Unavailable(JSException ex) =>
        new("localStorage is not available", ex);
}

FILE: src/ObserverMagazine.Web/Services/LocalStorageProgressStore.cs

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;

public sealed class LocalStorageProgressStore(IBrowserStorage storage) : IProgressStore
{
    private const string ProbeKey = "book:__probe";

    public ValueTask<string?> GetAsync(string key) => storage.GetAsync(key);

    public ValueTask SetAsync(string key, string value) => storage.SetAsync(key, value);

    public ValueTask RemoveAsync(string key) => storage.RemoveAsync(key);

    public async ValueTask<bool> IsPersistentAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            await storage.SetAsync(ProbeKey, "1");
            await storage.RemoveAsync(ProbeKey);
            return true;
        }
        catch (BrowserStorageException)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

        var rng = new Random(seed);
        var products = new List<CatalogProduct>(count);
        var baseDate = new DateTime(2024, 1, 1);
        var usedSkus = new HashSet<string>();

        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            var catEntry = Categories[rng.Next(Categories.Length)];
            var adj = Adjectives[rng.Next(Adjectives.Length)];
            var productType = catEntry.Products[rng.Next(catEntry.Products.Length)];
            var brand = catEntry.Brands[rng.Next(catEntry.Brands.Length)];
            var color = Colors[rng.Next(Colors.Length)];
            var name = $"{adj} {productType}";

            // Generate unique SKU
            string sku;
            do
            {
                sku = $"{catEntry.Category[..3].ToUpperInvariant()}-{rng.Next(10000, 99999)}";
            } while (!usedSkus.Add(sku));

            var priceRange = catEntry.MaxPrice - catEntry.MinPrice;
            var price = Math.Round(catEntry.MinPrice + (decimal)(rng.NextDouble() * (double)priceRange), 2);

            // ~30% chance of having a compare-at price (sale)
            decimal? compareAt = rng.NextDouble() < 0.3
                ? Math.Round(price * (1m + (decimal)(rng.NextDouble() * 0.4 + 0.1)), 2)
                : null;

            var weightRange = catEntry.MaxWeight - catEntry.MinWeight;
            var weight = Math.Round(catEntry.MinWeight + rng.NextDouble() * weightRange, 2);

            var warrantyRange = catEntry.MaxWarranty - catEntry.MinWarranty;
            var warranty = catEntry.MinWarranty + rng.Next(warrantyRange + 1);

            var rating = Math.Round(2.5 + rng.NextDouble() * 2.5, 1);
            var reviewCount = rng.Next(0, 2500);
            var stock = rng.Next(0, 1000);
            var daysAgo = rng.Next(0, 730);
            var status = Statuses[rng.Next(Statuses.Length)];

            products.Add(new CatalogProduct
            {
                Id = CreateDeterministicGuid(seed, i),
                Sku = sku,
                Name = name,
                Brand = brand,
                Category = catEntry.Category,
                Price = price,
                CompareAtPrice = compareAt,
                Stock = stock,
                Rating = rating,
                ReviewCount = reviewCount,
                WeightKg = weight,
                Color = color,
                WarrantyMonths = warranty,
                DateAdded = baseDate.AddDays(daysAgo),
                Status = status,
                Description = $"{adj} {productType.ToLowerInvariant()} by {brand}. Available in {color.ToLowerInvariant()}. {(warranty > 0 ? $"Includes {warranty}-month warranty." : "No warranty.")}"
            });
        }

        return products;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a deterministic GUID from a seed and index so we get the same IDs every time.
    /// </summary>
    private static Guid CreateDeterministicGuid(int seed, int index)
    {
        var bytes = new byte[16];
        BitConverter.GetBytes(seed).CopyTo(bytes, 0);
        BitConverter.GetBytes(index).CopyTo(bytes, 4);
        BitConverter.GetBytes(seed ^ unchecked((int)(index * 2654435761u))).CopyTo(bytes, 8);
        BitConverter.GetBytes(index ^ unchecked((int)(seed * 2246822519u))).CopyTo(bytes, 12);
        return new Guid(bytes);
    }
}

using ObserverMagazine.Web.Models;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;

public static class QuizEvaluator
{
    public static QuizResult Evaluate(QuizQuestion question, IEnumerable<string> selectedOptionIds)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(question);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(selectedOptionIds);

        var validIds = question.Options.Select(o => o.Id).ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        var selected = selectedOptionIds.Where(validIds.Contains).ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        var correct = question.Options.Where(o => o.Correct).Select(o => o.Id).ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal);

        var isCorrect = correct.Count > 0
            && selected.SetEquals(correct)
            && (question.MultipleAnswers || selected.Count == 1);

        return new QuizResult(isCorrect, selected, correct);
    }
}

FILE: src/ObserverMagazine.Web/Services/ReadingProgressService.cs
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
using System.Text.Json;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Models;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;

public sealed class ReadingProgressService(
    IProgressStore store,
    TimeProvider time,
    ILogger<ReadingProgressService> logger) : IReadingProgressService, IDisposable
{
    public const string KeyPrefix = "book:";

    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions JsonOptions = new(JsonSerializerDefaults.Web);

    private readonly Dictionary<string, BookProgress> _cache = [with(StringComparer.Ordinal)];
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim _gate = new(1, 1);

    public static string StorageKey(string bookSlug) => KeyPrefix + bookSlug;

    public async Task<BookProgress> GetAsync(string bookSlug)
    {
        await _gate.WaitAsync();
        try
        {
            return await LoadAsync(bookSlug);
        }
        finally
        {
            _gate.Release();
        }
    }

    public Task<VisitOutcome> RecordVisitAsync(string bookSlug, string chapterSlug, string subchapterSlug) =>
        MutateAsync(bookSlug, (progress, now) =>
        {
            var firstVisitToBook = progress.StartedAt is null;
            progress.StartedAt ??= now;

            var subchapter = GetOrAddSubchapter(progress, chapterSlug, subchapterSlug);
            var firstVisitToSubchapter = subchapter.FirstVisitedAt is null;
            subchapter.FirstVisitedAt ??= now;
            subchapter.LastVisitedAt = now;

            progress.LastChapterSlug = chapterSlug;
            progress.LastSubchapterSlug = subchapterSlug;

            return new VisitOutcome(progress, firstVisitToBook, firstVisitToSubchapter);
        });

    public Task<BookProgress> RecordAnswerAsync(
        string bookSlug,
        string chapterSlug,
        string subchapterSlug,
        string questionId,
        IReadOnlyCollection<string> selectedOptionIds,
        bool isCorrect) =>
        MutateAsync(bookSlug, (progress, now) =>
        {
            progress.StartedAt ??= now;

            var subchapter = GetOrAddSubchapter(progress, chapterSlug, subchapterSlug);
            subchapter.FirstVisitedAt ??= now;

            if (!subchapter.Questions.TryGetValue(questionId, out var question))
            {
                question = new QuestionProgress();
                subchapter.Questions[questionId] = question;
            }

            question.Attempts++;
            question.LastAttemptCorrect = isCorrect;
            question.AnsweredCorrectly |= isCorrect;
            question.LastSelection = selectedOptionIds.ToArray();
            question.LastAttemptAt = now;

            return progress;
        });

    public async Task<BookProgress> ResetAsync(string bookSlug)
    {
        await _gate.WaitAsync();
        try
        {
            var fresh = new BookProgress { BookSlug = bookSlug };
            _cache[bookSlug] = fresh;

            try
            {
                await store.RemoveAsync(StorageKey(bookSlug));
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                logger.LogWarning(ex, "Failed to remove stored progress for {Book}", bookSlug);
            }

            return fresh;
        }
        finally
        {
            _gate.Release();
        }
    }

    public async Task<bool> IsPersistentAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            return await store.IsPersistentAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            logger.LogDebug(ex, "Could not determine whether progress storage is persistent");
            return false;
        }
    }

    public void Dispose() => _gate.Dispose();

    private async Task<T> MutateAsync<T>(string bookSlug, Func<BookProgress, DateTimeOffset, T> mutation)
    {
        await _gate.WaitAsync();
        try
        {
            var progress = await LoadAsync(bookSlug);
            var now = time.GetUtcNow();
            var result = mutation(progress, now);
            progress.UpdatedAt = now;
            await SaveAsync(progress);
            return result;
        }
        finally
        {
            _gate.Release();
        }
    }

    private async Task<BookProgress> LoadAsync(string bookSlug)
    {
        if (_cache.TryGetValue(bookSlug, out var cached))
        {
            return cached;
        }

        var progress = await ReadAsync(bookSlug) ?? new BookProgress { BookSlug = bookSlug };
        _cache[bookSlug] = progress;
        return progress;
    }

    private async Task<BookProgress?> ReadAsync(string bookSlug)
    {
        string? json;
        try
        {
            json = await store.GetAsync(StorageKey(bookSlug));
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            logger.LogWarning(ex, "Failed to read stored progress for {Book}", bookSlug);
            return null;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json))
        {
            return null;
        }

        try
        {
            var progress = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<BookProgress>(json, JsonOptions);
            if (progress is null ||
                progress.SchemaVersion != BookProgress.CurrentSchemaVersion ||
                !string.Equals(progress.BookSlug, bookSlug, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                logger.LogWarning("Discarding incompatible stored progress for {Book}", bookSlug);
                return null;
            }

            return Normalize(progress);
        }
        catch (JsonException ex)
        {
            logger.LogWarning(ex, "Discarding corrupt stored progress for {Book}", bookSlug);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private async Task SaveAsync(BookProgress progress)
    {
        try
        {
            await store.SetAsync(StorageKey(progress.BookSlug), JsonSerializer.Serialize(progress, JsonOptions));
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            logger.LogWarning(ex, "Failed to save progress for {Book}", progress.BookSlug);
        }
    }

    private static SubchapterProgress GetOrAddSubchapter(BookProgress progress, string chapterSlug, string subchapterSlug)
    {
        var key = BookProgress.SubchapterKey(chapterSlug, subchapterSlug);
        if (!progress.Subchapters.TryGetValue(key, out var subchapter))
        {
            subchapter = new SubchapterProgress();
            progress.Subchapters[key] = subchapter;
        }
        return subchapter;
    }

    private static BookProgress Normalize(BookProgress progress)
    {
        Dictionary<string, SubchapterProgress> subchapters = [with(StringComparer.Ordinal)];

        foreach (var (key, subchapter) in progress.Subchapters ?? [])
        {
            if (subchapter is null)
            {
                continue;
            }

            Dictionary<string, QuestionProgress> questions = [with(StringComparer.Ordinal)];
            foreach (var (questionId, question) in subchapter.Questions ?? [])
            {
                if (question is null)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                question.LastSelection ??= [];
                questions[questionId] = question;
            }

            subchapter.Questions = questions;
            subchapters[key] = subchapter;
        }

        progress.Subchapters = subchapters;
        return progress;
    }
}

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;

public sealed class TelemetryService(ILogger<TelemetryService> logger)
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, long> _counters = [];
    private readonly Lock _lock = new();

    public void TrackEvent(string eventName, IDictionary<string, string>? properties = null)
    {
        var props = properties is not null
            ? string.Join(", ", properties.Select(kv => $"{kv.Key}={kv.Value}"))
            : "";
        logger.LogInformation("[Telemetry] Event: {EventName} {Properties}", eventName, props);
    }

    public void IncrementCounter(string counterName, long value = 1)
    {
        lock (_lock)
        {
            _counters.TryGetValue(counterName, out var current);
            _counters[counterName] = current + value;
        }
        logger.LogDebug("[Telemetry] Counter: {CounterName} += {Value}", counterName, value);
    }

    public long GetCounter(string counterName)
    {
        lock (_lock)
        {
            return _counters.GetValueOrDefault(counterName, 0);
        }
    }

    public void TrackPageView(string pageName)
    {
        IncrementCounter($"pageview:{pageName}");
        TrackEvent("PageView", new Dictionary<string, string> { ["page"] = pageName });
    }
}

FILE: src/ObserverMagazine.Web/wwwroot/plaintext/2026-04-26-zelensky.txt

Opinion

David French
Meet the New Leader of the Free World
April 26, 2026

A remarkable thing has happened on the world’s battlefields. Ukraine — a nation that was supposed to dissolve within days of a Russian invasion — has fought Russia to a stalemate, revolutionizing land warfare in the process. It has become an indispensable security partner in the western alliance, including in the war against Iran.

Now, Volodymyr Zelensky, Ukraine’s president, is taking the next step, one that would have been unthinkable even as recently as 2024. By word and deed, he’s showing Europe and the world how the post-American free world can preserve its liberty and independence. This is what happens when, as Phillips Payson O’Brien wrote in a piece for The Atlantic, “Kyiv appears to have given up on the United States.”

If that is true — and it looks as though it is — it may be worse news for the United States than it is for Ukraine.

Events on the ground and in world capitals are moving so quickly that it’s hard to keep up. First, the strategic situation in the Ukraine war seems to have changed. Last week, Mick Ryan, a retired Australian major general and one of the most astute analysts of the war, wrote that Ukraine has largely stabilized the frontline in eastern Ukraine, deepened its coalition, isolated Russia diplomatically and developed an indigenous arms industry that makes it less dependent on external support.

It’s no longer accurate to think of Ukraine as a desperate underdog; it’s becoming an independent power. Even as it fights for its life against Russia, it’s reportedly reaching defense deals with the Gulf states and with the United States — and this time it’s Ukraine that’s providing military assistance.

In February 2025, Donald Trump mocked Zelensky in the Oval Office. “You’re not in a good position. You don’t have the cards right now,” Trump said. In April 2026, Ukraine has enough cards left that it’s sharing them.

This might be difficult for many readers to grasp — given our nation’s longstanding military supremacy — but the largest and most battle-hardened land force in the western world may well be the Ukrainian Army. While the precise numbers are classified, the Atlantic Council estimated in 2025 that Ukraine had roughly a million men and women under arms, the vast majority of whom serve in the ground forces.

America’s total force is larger than Ukraine’s, but to put the size of Ukrainian land forces in perspective, the combined size of the U.S. Army and Marine Corps is around 620,000. It’s also worth noting that the U.S. forces have much less combat experience than Ukraine forces — especially when it comes to combat with a great power.

No one should minimize Ukraine’s manpower issues (more recent estimates place its total number of active troops well below the million-body peak) or the fact that it has no nuclear weapons and Russia has thousands. But its army is still vast, and its military is the only western force that has fully adapted to modern drone warfare. Indeed, Ukraine is arguably the world’s leader in drone warfare.

Rapid change isn’t just occurring in Ukraine. Other developments across the western alliance show that European nations are working with shocking speed to free themselves from dependence on America.

France is expanding its nuclear arsenal and increasing its defense spending. It is even changing its nuclear doctrine to allow it to deploy nuclear-armed aircraft outside France.

Germany has approved a plan to spend up to a trillion euros on defense and infrastructure. It has also set the goal of creating the strongest military in Europe by 2039 (ironically enough, the 100-year anniversary of the German invasion of Poland).

Canada is enacting its own defense budget increases — with the added twist that it will be spending far less money on American weapons.

This decision mirrors larger European and allied trends. Our allies are increasing their defense budgets and decreasing their dependence on American technology. Just last week, for example, NATO procurement officials decided to replace aging American-made early warning aircraft with newer designs from Saab, a Swedish manufacturer, and Bombardier of Canada. Ukraine has signed deals and letters of intent to purchase potentially hundreds of advanced fighters from Sweden and France.

All of this is taking place after news reports that Denmark had been prepared to blow up airfields in Greenland if its fellow NATO member, the United States, attempted to invade.

Given these developments, is it any wonder that Zelensky has proposed a new defense arrangement for Europe if America keeps stepping back — an alliance between E.U. nations, plus non-E.U. powers like the United Kingdom, Norway, Turkey and Ukraine?

There are readers who will welcome these developments. Good, you might think. Europe should take primary responsibility for its own defense. But there is an immense difference between allies who step up to contribute their fair share to a cooperative alliance and nations who engage in a military buildup to replace American power, which they no longer trust.

I don’t think Americans fully appreciate the extraordinary cost of Trump’s bluster and blunders. It should go without saying, but once you threaten to invade an allied country, you don’t just place the existence of the alliance in jeopardy; you raise the possibility of allies turning into mortal enemies. You can also trigger the kind of insecurity and scramble for power that contributed to the start of World War I.

In practical terms, it’s hard to see how alienating American allies puts America first.

There’s certainly no military benefit. Americans have spent the last several weeks watching our president dismiss our European allies as irrelevant then rage at them for not helping American forces reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

By launching the war against Iran without seeking the help of (or even consulting) our European allies, we lost potential access to their advanced fighters and frigates, as well as to France’s carrier battle group. In this context, there is no such thing as addition by subtraction. We are not stronger when there are fewer forces that will deploy to our aid.

There’s no fiscal benefit, either. This may sound overly basic, but it needs to be said: If you break faith with your allies, you can’t count on them to come to your defense. And that means you have to spend more money to maintain the same level of deterrence.

That’s exactly what Trump is planning to do; he has submitted a roughly $1.5 trillion budget request for the U.S. military, a staggering 40 percent increase from this fiscal year.

And where is the economic benefit? On Friday, Fareed Zakaria published a piece in The Washington Post observing that European and other allied governments aren’t just attempting to achieve greater military independence from the United States; they’re also attempting to gain more financial independence. And even though they have serious differences with China, the primary beneficiary of a rift in European and American relations may well be … China.

Zakaria quotes a Chinese businessman who puts Trump’s catastrophic diplomatic blunders in perspective. “For us, Trump’s attack on Iran is less consequential than his threat to attack Greenland,” he said. “When he did that, to America’s oldest allies, I knew that Europe would not follow America’s approach to China.”

History has its hinge points, and here is one: On Friday night, Feb. 25, 2022, Volodymyr Zelensky released a brief video from Kyiv. He told the people of Ukraine that the government has not fled to safety in the west and that it intended to stand and fight.

“We are here,” Zelensky said. “We are in Kyiv. We are protecting Ukraine.”

When I visited Ukraine in 2023, I spoke to Ukrainian soldiers who told me that statement sent a jolt of electricity through Ukrainian lines. From that moment, they knew they would not surrender; they would stand.

In hindsight, that decision hasn’t just changed the course of Ukrainian history. Its ripple effects are extending across the globe.

Here’s another hinge point: the night of Nov. 5, 2024, when the American people returned Donald Trump to the White House. It’s now clear that Trump’s second term will cause generational damage to American alliances.

Given that Americans saw how Trump behaved in his first term and put him back in power anyway, it’s fair for Europeans to conclude that the rift isn’t with Trump alone; its also with a critical mass of Americans.

The European nations don’t have the luxury of blaming Trump’s re-election on inflation and the border — or presuming that the western alliance will be safe once Trump is gone. One of Trump’s most likely heirs, JD Vance, is arguably even more hostile to the western alliance and Ukraine than Trump is. After all, Vance recently said that one of the things he’s “proudest” of is the administration’s decision to stop buying weapons for Ukraine. How can we be trusted as an ally if only one political party is committed to fulfilling our commitments?

For the foreseeable future, America’s allies will reasonably fear that they may be one election away from abandonment and betrayal.

Politics abhors a vacuum. When America stepped back, other nations were bound to step forward.

While America is still the world’s most powerful nation and it remains (for now) in NATO, it is rapidly forfeiting its role as the leader of the free world. And while we have certainly made mistakes in that role, we did lead the NATO alliance to victory in its generations-long confrontation with the Soviet Union. And we did so without treading into another catastrophic world war.

But you cannot threaten the free world and lead it at the same time. No nation can match American might, but for the first time in my adult life, the moral and strategic heart of the defense of liberal democracy doesn’t beat in Washington. It doesn’t beat in London or Paris or Berlin or Ottawa, either. It’s in Kyiv, where a courageous leader and a courageous people have picked up the torch America has dropped.

The Times is committed to publishing a diversity of letters to the editor. We’d like to hear what you think about this or any of our articles. Here are some tips. And here’s our email: letters@nytimes.com.

Follow the New York Times Opinion section on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Bluesky, WhatsApp and Threads.

David French is an Opinion columnist, writing about law, culture, religion and armed conflict. He is a veteran of Operation Iraqi Freedom and a former constitutional litigator. His most recent book is “Divided We Fall: America’s Secession Threat and How to Restore Our Nation.” You can follow him on Threads (@davidfrenchjag). 

https://www.nytimes.com/2026/04/26/opinion/zelensky-ukraine-trump-nato-leader.html

FILE: tests/ObserverMagazine.Integration.Tests/BookCompilerTests.cs
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
using System.Text.Json;
using ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor;
using ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor.Books;
using Xunit;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Integration.Tests;

public sealed class BookCompilerTests : IDisposable
{
    private static readonly DateTime PublishBefore = new(2026, 12, 31);

    private readonly string _root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "book-tests-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
    private string BooksDir => Path.Combine(_root, "books");

    private static readonly Dictionary<string, AuthorProfile> Authors = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    {
        ["team"] = new AuthorProfile { Id = "team", Name = "The Team" }
    };

    private const string ValidSubchapter = """
        ---
        title: Hello
        questions:
          - id: pick
            prompt: Pick B
            options:
              - text: A
              - text: B
                correct: true
        ---
        Some **content** here.
        """;

    private void WriteFile(string relativePath, string content)
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(BooksDir, relativePath);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path)!);
        File.WriteAllText(path, content);
    }

    private void WriteValidBook(string slug = "my-book", string date = "2026-01-01")
    {
        WriteFile($"{slug}/book.yml", $"title: My Book\nauthor: team\ndate: {date}\nsummary: A book\ntags: [one]\n");
        WriteFile($"{slug}/02-second/chapter.yml", "title: Second\n");
        WriteFile($"{slug}/02-second/01-only.md", "---\ntitle: Only\n---\nText.\n");
        WriteFile($"{slug}/01-first/chapter.yml", "title: First\nsummary: Start here\n");
        WriteFile($"{slug}/01-first/10-later.md", "---\ntitle: Later\n---\nLater text.\n");
        WriteFile($"{slug}/01-first/02-hello.md", ValidSubchapter);
    }

    private (IReadOnlyList<CompiledBook> Books, BuildDiagnostics Diagnostics) Compile()
    {
        var diagnostics = new BuildDiagnostics();
        var books = new BookCompiler(Authors, PublishBefore, diagnostics, TextWriter.Null).Compile(BooksDir);
        return (books, diagnostics);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MissingBooksDirectory_ReturnsNoBooks()
    {
        var (books, diagnostics) = Compile();

        Assert.Empty(books);
        Assert.False(diagnostics.HasErrors);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ValidBook_IsCompiledWithSequentialNumbering()
    {
        WriteValidBook();

        var (books, diagnostics) = Compile();

        Assert.False(diagnostics.HasErrors, string.Join("\n", diagnostics.Errors));
        var book = Assert.Single(books);
        Assert.Equal("my-book", book.Index.Slug);
        Assert.Equal("The Team", book.Index.AuthorName);
        Assert.Equal(2, book.Index.ChapterCount);
        Assert.Equal(3, book.Index.SubchapterCount);
        Assert.Equal(1, book.Index.QuestionCount);

        var first = book.Toc.Chapters[0];
        Assert.Equal((1, "first"), (first.Number, first.Slug));
        Assert.Equal(["hello", "later"], first.Subchapters.Select(s => s.Slug).ToArray());
        Assert.Equal([1, 2], first.Subchapters.Select(s => s.Number).ToArray());
        Assert.Equal(["pick"], first.Subchapters[0].QuestionIds);
        Assert.Equal((2, "second"), (book.Toc.Chapters[1].Number, book.Toc.Chapters[1].Slug));

        var hello = book.Documents.Single(d => d.Slug == "hello");
        Assert.Contains("<strong>content</strong>", hello.Html);
        Assert.Equal(1, hello.ChapterNumber);
        Assert.Equal("b", hello.Questions[0].Options.Single(o => o.Correct).Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DraftAndFutureContent_IsSkipped()
    {
        WriteValidBook();
        WriteFile("my-book/01-first/03-draft.md", "---\ntitle: Draft\ndraft: true\n---\nHidden.\n");
        WriteFile("future-book/book.yml", "title: Future\ndate: 2099-01-01\n");
        WriteFile("future-book/01-a/chapter.yml", "title: A\n");
        WriteFile("future-book/01-a/01-b.md", "---\ntitle: B\n---\nB.\n");
        WriteFile("draft-book/book.yml", "title: Draft\ndate: 2026-01-01\ndraft: true\n");

        var (books, diagnostics) = Compile();

        Assert.False(diagnostics.HasErrors);
        var book = Assert.Single(books);
        Assert.Equal(3, book.Index.SubchapterCount);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void UnnumberedSubchapter_IsError()
    {
        WriteValidBook();
        WriteFile("my-book/01-first/no-number.md", "---\ntitle: Oops\n---\nText.\n");

        var (_, diagnostics) = Compile();

        Assert.Contains(diagnostics.Errors, e => e.Contains("no-number.md"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MissingChapterManifest_IsError()
    {
        WriteValidBook();
        WriteFile("my-book/03-third/01-x.md", "---\ntitle: X\n---\nX.\n");

        var (_, diagnostics) = Compile();

        Assert.Contains(diagnostics.Errors, e => e.Contains("chapter.yml") && e.Contains("missing"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void InvalidQuestion_IsError()
    {
        WriteValidBook();
        WriteFile("my-book/01-first/04-bad.md", """
            ---
            title: Bad
            questions:
              - prompt: No correct answer
                options:
                  - text: A
                  - text: B
            ---
            Body.
            """);

        var (_, diagnostics) = Compile();

        Assert.Contains(diagnostics.Errors, e => e.Contains("04-bad.md"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MalformedYaml_IsErrorNotCrash()
    {
        WriteValidBook();
        WriteFile("my-book/01-first/05-broken.md", "---\ntitle: [unclosed\n---\nBody.\n");

        var (_, diagnostics) = Compile();

        Assert.Contains(diagnostics.Errors, e => e.Contains("05-broken.md"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void UnknownAuthor_IsWarning()
    {
        WriteValidBook();
        WriteFile("my-book/book.yml", "title: My Book\nauthor: nobody\ndate: 2026-01-01\n");

        var (books, diagnostics) = Compile();

        Assert.False(diagnostics.HasErrors);
        Assert.Contains(diagnostics.Warnings, w => w.Contains("nobody"));
        Assert.Equal("nobody", books[0].Index.AuthorName);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Books_AreSortedNewestFirst()
    {
        WriteValidBook("old-book", "2026-01-01");
        WriteValidBook("new-book", "2026-06-01");

        var (books, _) = Compile();

        Assert.Equal(["new-book", "old-book"], books.Select(b => b.Index.Slug).ToArray());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Writer_ProducesExpectedFileLayout()
    {
        WriteValidBook();
        var (books, _) = Compile();
        var outputDir = Path.Combine(_root, "out");
        var jsonOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase };

        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.Combine(outputDir, BookOutputWriter.DataDirectoryName, "stale"));
        var dataDir = BookOutputWriter.Write(books, outputDir, jsonOptions);

        Assert.False(Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(dataDir, "stale")));
        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(dataDir, "books-index.json")));
        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(dataDir, "my-book", "toc.json")));
        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(dataDir, "my-book", "first", "hello.json")));
        Assert.True(File.Exists(Path.Combine(dataDir, "my-book", "second", "only.json")));

        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(dataDir, "my-book", "first", "hello.json")));
        var question = doc.RootElement.GetProperty("questions")[0];
        Assert.Equal("pick", question.GetProperty("id").GetString());
        Assert.False(question.GetProperty("multipleAnswers").GetBoolean());
        Assert.True(question.GetProperty("options")[1].GetProperty("correct").GetBoolean());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FrontMatterParser_GenericParse_IgnoresDashesInsideValues()
    {
        var (frontMatter, body) = FrontMatterParser.Parse<SubchapterFrontMatter>("---\ntitle: a---b\n---\nBody\n");

        Assert.Equal("a---b", frontMatter.Title);
        Assert.Equal("Body\n", body);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("01-intro", true, 1, "intro")]
    [InlineData("12_multi-word-slug", true, 12, "multi-word-slug")]
    [InlineData("intro", false, 0, "")]
    [InlineData("01-Upper", false, 0, "")]
    [InlineData("01-", false, 0, "")]
    public void ContentNaming_ParsesNumberedNames(string name, bool expected, int order, string slug)
    {
        var success = ContentNaming.TryParseNumbered(name, out var actualOrder, out var actualSlug);

        Assert.Equal(expected, success);
        Assert.Equal(order, actualOrder);
        Assert.Equal(slug, actualSlug);
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (Directory.Exists(_root))
        {
            Directory.Delete(_root, recursive: true);
        }
    }
}

using System.Xml.Linq;
using Markdig;
using YamlDotNet.Serialization;
using YamlDotNet.Serialization.NamingConventions;
using Xunit;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Integration.Tests;

public class ContentProcessorTests
{
    private static readonly XNamespace ContentNs = "http://purl.org/rss/1.0/modules/content/";

    [Fact]
    public void FrontMatter_ParsesAllFields()
    {
        var markdown = """
            ---
            title: Test Post
            date: 2026-03-01
            author: terlingua-team
            summary: A test summary
            tags:
              - test
              - integration
            featured: true
            series: Test Series
            image: /images/test.jpg
            ---
            ## Hello

            This is the body.
            """;

        var (frontMatter, body) = ParseFrontMatter(markdown);

        Assert.Equal("Test Post", frontMatter.Title);
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2026, 3, 1), frontMatter.Date);
        Assert.Equal("terlingua-team", frontMatter.Author);
        Assert.Equal("A test summary", frontMatter.Summary);
        Assert.Equal(["test", "integration"], frontMatter.Tags!);
        Assert.True(frontMatter.Featured);
        Assert.Equal("Test Series", frontMatter.Series);
        Assert.Equal("/images/test.jpg", frontMatter.Image);
        Assert.False(frontMatter.Draft);
        Assert.Contains("## Hello", body);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FrontMatter_HandlesMissingFields()
    {
        var markdown = """
            ---
            title: Minimal Post
            date: 2026-01-01
            ---
            Body content.
            """;

        var (frontMatter, body) = ParseFrontMatter(markdown);

        Assert.Equal("Minimal Post", frontMatter.Title);
        Assert.Null(frontMatter.Author);
        Assert.Null(frontMatter.Tags);
        Assert.False(frontMatter.Featured);
        Assert.False(frontMatter.Draft);
        Assert.Null(frontMatter.Series);
        Assert.Null(frontMatter.Image);
        Assert.Contains("Body content.", body);
    }

    [Fact]

        Assert.Contains("<strong>bold</strong>", html);
        Assert.Contains("<em>italic</em>", html);
    }

    }

    [Fact]
    public void SlugDerivation_StripsDatePrefix()
    {
        Assert.Equal("welcome-post", DeriveSlug("2026-01-15-welcome-post"));
        Assert.Equal("no-date", DeriveSlug("no-date"));
        Assert.Equal("short", DeriveSlug("short"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReadingTime_CalculatesCorrectly()
    {
        // 200 words = 1 minute, 400 words = 2 minutes
        var shortText = string.Join(" ", Enumerable.Repeat("word", 50));
        Assert.Equal(1, CalculateReadingTime(shortText)); // minimum 1 minute

        var mediumText = string.Join(" ", Enumerable.Repeat("word", 400));
        Assert.Equal(2, CalculateReadingTime(mediumText));

        var longText = string.Join(" ", Enumerable.Repeat("word", 1000));
        Assert.Equal(5, CalculateReadingTime(longText));
    }

        Assert.Equal("https://example.com", channel.Element("link")!.Value);

    }

    // --- Helpers duplicated from ContentProcessor for isolated testing ---

    private static (TestFrontMatter, string) ParseFrontMatter(string rawContent)
    {
        var deserializer = new DeserializerBuilder()
            .WithNamingConvention(CamelCaseNamingConvention.Instance)
            .IgnoreUnmatchedProperties()
            .Build();

        if (!rawContent.StartsWith("---"))
            return (new TestFrontMatter(), rawContent);

        var endIndex = rawContent.IndexOf("---", 3, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        if (endIndex < 0)
            return (new TestFrontMatter(), rawContent);

        var yaml = rawContent[3..endIndex].Trim();
        var body = rawContent[(endIndex + 3)..].TrimStart('\r', '\n');
        var fm = deserializer.Deserialize<TestFrontMatter>(yaml);
        return (fm, body);
    }

    private static string DeriveSlug(string fileName)
    {
        if (fileName.Length > 11 &&
            char.IsDigit(fileName[0]) &&
            fileName[4] == '-' &&
            fileName[7] == '-' &&
            fileName[10] == '-')
        {
            return fileName[11..];
        }
        return fileName;
    }

    private static int CalculateReadingTime(string markdownBody)
    {
        var wordCount = markdownBody
            .Split([' ', '\n', '\r', '\t'], StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
            .Length;
        return Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(wordCount / 200.0));
    }

    private static string GenerateRss(
        string title, string description, string siteUrl,
        IReadOnlyList<RssPostEntry> posts,
        Func<string, string?>? getPostHtml = null)
    {
        var items = posts.Select(p =>
        {
            var itemElements = new List<object>
            {
                new XElement("title", p.Title),
                new XElement("link", $"{siteUrl}/blog/{p.Slug}"),
                new XElement("description", p.Summary),
                new XElement("pubDate", p.Date.ToString("R")),
                new XElement("guid", $"{siteUrl}/blog/{p.Slug}")
            };

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(p.AuthorEmail))
            {
                itemElements.Add(new XElement("author", $"{p.AuthorEmail} ({p.AuthorName})"));
            }

            var html = getPostHtml?.Invoke(p.Slug);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(html))
            {
                itemElements.Add(new XElement(ContentNs + "encoded", new XCData(html)));
            }

            if (p.Tags.Length > 0)
            {
                itemElements.AddRange(p.Tags.Select(t => new XElement("category", t)));
            }

            return new XElement("item", itemElements);
        });

        var rss = new XDocument(
            new XDeclaration("1.0", "utf-8", null),
            new XElement("rss",
                new XAttribute("version", "2.0"),
                new XAttribute(XNamespace.Xmlns + "content", ContentNs),
                new XElement("channel",
                    new XElement("title", title),
                    new XElement("link", siteUrl),
                    new XElement("description", description),
                    new XElement("language", "en-us"),
                    new XElement("lastBuildDate", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("R")),
                    items
                )
            )
        );

        return rss.Declaration + Environment.NewLine + rss;
    }
}

public sealed class TestFrontMatter
{
    public string Title { get; init; } = "";
    public DateTime Date { get; init; }
    public DateTime? Updated { get; init; }
    public string? Author { get; init; }
    public string? Summary { get; init; }
    public string[]? Tags { get; init; }
    public bool Draft { get; init; }
    public bool Featured { get; init; }
    public string? Series { get; init; }
    public string? Image { get; init; }
}

FILE: tests/ObserverMagazine.Integration.Tests/QuestionCompilerTests.cs

using ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor.Books;
using Xunit;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Integration.Tests;

public class QuestionCompilerTests
{
    private static QuestionDefinition Question(string? type, params (string Text, bool Correct)[] options) => new()
    {
        Prompt = "Which?",
        Type = type,
        Options = options.Select(o => new OptionDefinition { Text = o.Text, Correct = o.Correct }).ToList()
    };

    private static (IReadOnlyList<QuestionDocument> Questions, BuildDiagnostics Diagnostics) Compile(params QuestionDefinition[] definitions)
    {
        var diagnostics = new BuildDiagnostics();
        return (QuestionCompiler.Compile(definitions, "test.md", diagnostics), diagnostics);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void InfersSingleAnswer_WhenOneOptionCorrect()
    {
        var (questions, diagnostics) = Compile(Question(null, ("A", true), ("B", false)));

        Assert.False(diagnostics.HasErrors);
        var question = Assert.Single(questions);
        Assert.False(question.MultipleAnswers);
        Assert.Equal("q1", question.Id);
        Assert.Equal(["a", "b"], question.Options.Select(o => o.Id).ToArray());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void InfersMultipleAnswers_WhenSeveralOptionsCorrect()
    {
        var (questions, _) = Compile(Question(null, ("A", true), ("B", true), ("C", false)));

        Assert.True(questions[0].MultipleAnswers);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ExplicitMultiple_AllowsSingleCorrectOption()
    {
        var (questions, diagnostics) = Compile(Question("multiple", ("A", true), ("B", false)));

        Assert.False(diagnostics.HasErrors);
        Assert.True(questions[0].MultipleAnswers);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ExplicitSingle_WithSeveralCorrectOptions_IsError()
    {
        var (questions, diagnostics) = Compile(Question("single", ("A", true), ("B", true)));

        Assert.True(diagnostics.HasErrors);
        Assert.Empty(questions);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("bogus")]
    [InlineData("checkbox")]
    public void UnknownType_IsError(string type)
    {
        var (_, diagnostics) = Compile(Question(type, ("A", true), ("B", false)));

        Assert.True(diagnostics.HasErrors);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NoCorrectOption_IsError()
    {
        var (_, diagnostics) = Compile(Question(null, ("A", false), ("B", false)));

        Assert.Contains(diagnostics.Errors, e => e.Contains("marked correct"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TooFewOptions_IsError()
    {
        var (_, diagnostics) = Compile(Question(null, ("A", true)));

        Assert.Contains(diagnostics.Errors, e => e.Contains("at least 2 options"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MissingPrompt_IsError()
    {
        var definition = new QuestionDefinition
        {
            Options = [new OptionDefinition { Text = "A", Correct = true }, new OptionDefinition { Text = "B" }]
        };

        var (_, diagnostics) = Compile(definition);

        Assert.Contains(diagnostics.Errors, e => e.Contains("prompt is required"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DuplicateQuestionIds_AreErrors()
    {
        var first = new QuestionDefinition { Id = "same", Prompt = "1", Options = [new() { Text = "A", Correct = true }, new() { Text = "B" }] };
        var second = new QuestionDefinition { Id = "same", Prompt = "2", Options = [new() { Text = "A", Correct = true }, new() { Text = "B" }] };

        var (questions, diagnostics) = Compile(first, second);

        Assert.Single(questions);
        Assert.Contains(diagnostics.Errors, e => e.Contains("duplicate question id"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void InvalidQuestionId_IsError()
    {
        var definition = new QuestionDefinition { Id = "Bad Id", Prompt = "?", Options = [new() { Text = "A", Correct = true }, new() { Text = "B" }] };

        var (_, diagnostics) = Compile(definition);

        Assert.True(diagnostics.HasErrors);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Markdown_IsRenderedInPromptOptionsAndExplanation()
    {
        var definition = new QuestionDefinition
        {
            Prompt = "What does `var` do?",
            Explanation = "It **infers** the type.",
            Options = [new() { Text = "Infers the `type`", Correct = true }, new() { Text = "Nothing" }]
        };

        var (questions, _) = Compile(definition);
        var question = questions[0];

        Assert.Contains("<code>var</code>", question.PromptHtml);
        Assert.Contains("<strong>infers</strong>", question.ExplanationHtml);
        Assert.Equal("Infers the <code>type</code>", question.Options[0].TextHtml);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DefaultOptionIds_FollowLettersThenNumbers()
    {
        Assert.Equal("a", QuestionCompiler.DefaultOptionId(0));
        Assert.Equal("z", QuestionCompiler.DefaultOptionId(25));
        Assert.Equal("o27", QuestionCompiler.DefaultOptionId(26));
    }
}

using System.Xml.Linq;
using Xunit;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Integration.Tests;

public class RssGeneratorTests
{
    private static readonly XNamespace ContentNs = "http://purl.org/rss/1.0/modules/content/";

    [Fact]
    public void GenerateRss_ProducesValidXml()
    {
        var posts = new List<RssPostEntry>
        {
            new()
            {
                Slug = "test-post",
                Title = "Test Post",
                Date = new DateTime(2026, 3, 1),
                Summary = "A test post",
                Tags = ["test"]
            }
        };

        var xml = GenerateRss("Test Blog", "A blog", "https://example.com", posts);

        var doc = XDocument.Parse(xml);
        var channel = doc.Root!.Element("channel")!;

        Assert.Equal("Test Blog", channel.Element("title")!.Value);
        Assert.Equal("https://example.com", channel.Element("link")!.Value);

        var item = channel.Element("item")!;
        Assert.Equal("Test Post", item.Element("title")!.Value);
        Assert.Equal("https://example.com/blog/test-post", item.Element("link")!.Value);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GenerateRss_HandlesEmptyPostList()
    {
        var xml = GenerateRss("Empty Blog", "Nothing here", "https://example.com", []);
        var doc = XDocument.Parse(xml);
        var items = doc.Root!.Element("channel")!.Elements("item");
        Assert.Empty(items);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GenerateRss_IncludesCategoryTags()
    {
        var posts = new List<RssPostEntry>
        {
            new()
            {
                Slug = "tagged",
                Title = "Tagged Post",
                Date = new DateTime(2026, 1, 1),
                Summary = "Has tags",
                Tags = ["alpha", "beta"]
            }
        };

        var xml = GenerateRss("Blog", "Desc", "https://example.com", posts);
        var doc = XDocument.Parse(xml);
        var categories = doc.Root!.Element("channel")!
            .Element("item")!.Elements("category").Select(c => c.Value).ToArray();

        Assert.Equal(["alpha", "beta"], categories);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GenerateRss_IncludesFullContentWhenProvided()
    {
        var posts = new List<RssPostEntry>
        {
            new()
            {
                Slug = "full-content",
                Title = "Full Content Post",
                Date = new DateTime(2026, 2, 1),
                Summary = "Has full content",
                Tags = []
            }
        };

        var htmlMap = new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            ["full-content"] = "<p>This is the <strong>full</strong> content.</p>"
        };

        var xml = GenerateRss("Blog", "Desc", "https://example.com", posts,
            slug => htmlMap.GetValueOrDefault(slug));

        var doc = XDocument.Parse(xml);
        var item = doc.Root!.Element("channel")!.Element("item")!;
        var encoded = item.Element(ContentNs + "encoded");

        Assert.NotNull(encoded);
        Assert.Contains("<strong>full</strong>", encoded.Value);
    }

    // --- RSS generation logic (mirrors ContentProcessor) ---
    private static string GenerateRss(
        string title, string description, string siteUrl,
        IReadOnlyList<RssPostEntry> posts,
        Func<string, string?>? getPostHtml = null)
    {
        var items = posts.Select(p =>
        {
            var itemElements = new List<object>
            {
                new XElement("title", p.Title),
                new XElement("link", $"{siteUrl}/blog/{p.Slug}"),
                new XElement("description", p.Summary),
                new XElement("pubDate", p.Date.ToString("R")),
                new XElement("guid", $"{siteUrl}/blog/{p.Slug}")
            };

            var html = getPostHtml?.Invoke(p.Slug);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(html))
            {
                itemElements.Add(new XElement(ContentNs + "encoded", new XCData(html)));
            }

            if (p.Tags.Length > 0)
            {
                itemElements.AddRange(p.Tags.Select(t => new XElement("category", t)));
            }

            return new XElement("item", itemElements);
        });

        var rss = new XDocument(
            new XDeclaration("1.0", "utf-8", null),
            new XElement("rss",
                new XAttribute("version", "2.0"),
                new XAttribute(XNamespace.Xmlns + "content", ContentNs),
                new XElement("channel",
                    new XElement("title", title),
                    new XElement("link", siteUrl),
                    new XElement("description", description),
                    new XElement("language", "en-us"),
                    new XElement("lastBuildDate", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("R")),
                    items
                )
            )
        );

        return rss.Declaration + Environment.NewLine + rss;
    }
}

}

using ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor;
using Xunit;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Integration.Tests;

public class SyntaxHighlighterTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData("csharp", "var name = $\"Hi {x}\"; // greet\nList<int> items = [1, 2];",
        "<span class=\"hl-keyword\">var</span> name = <span class=\"hl-string\">$\"Hi {x}\"</span>; <span class=\"hl-comment\">// greet</span>\n<span class=\"hl-type\">List</span>&lt;<span class=\"hl-keyword\">int</span>&gt; items = [<span class=\"hl-number\">1</span>, <span class=\"hl-number\">2</span>];")]
    [InlineData("json", "{\"id\": 1, \"ok\": true}",
        "{<span class=\"hl-attr\">\"id\"</span>: <span class=\"hl-number\">1</span>, <span class=\"hl-attr\">\"ok\"</span>: <span class=\"hl-literal\">true</span>}")]
    [InlineData("yml", "title: Hello\ndraft: false",
        "<span class=\"hl-attr\">title</span>: Hello\n<span class=\"hl-attr\">draft</span>: <span class=\"hl-literal\">false</span>")]
    [InlineData("html", "<a href=\"/x\">Go</a>",
        "&lt;<span class=\"hl-tag\">a</span> <span class=\"hl-attr\">href</span>=<span class=\"hl-string\">\"/x\"</span>&gt;Go&lt;/<span class=\"hl-tag\">a</span>&gt;")]
    [InlineData("css", ".a { color: #fff; }",
        "<span class=\"hl-selector\">.a </span>{ <span class=\"hl-property\">color</span>: <span class=\"hl-number\">#fff</span>; }")]
    [InlineData("sql", "select * from Users -- all",
        "<span class=\"hl-keyword\">select</span> * <span class=\"hl-keyword\">from</span> <span class=\"hl-type\">Users</span> <span class=\"hl-comment\">-- all</span>")]
    [InlineData("", "if (a < b && c > d) {}",
        "<span class=\"hl-function\">if</span> (a &lt; b &amp;&amp; c &gt; d) {}")]
    public void Highlights(string language, string code, string expected)
    {
        Assert.Equal(expected, SyntaxHighlighter.Highlight(code, language));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FencedCodeIsHighlightedAtBuildTime()
    {
        var html = MarkdownProcessor.ToHtml("```csharp\nvar x = 1;\n```");

        Assert.Contains("<pre><code class=\"language-csharp\">", html);
        Assert.Contains("<span class=\"hl-keyword\">var</span>", html);
        Assert.Contains("</code></pre>", html);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MarkupInCodeIsEscaped()
    {
        var html = MarkdownProcessor.ToHtml("```html\n<script>alert(1)</script>\n```");

        Assert.DoesNotContain("<script>", html);
        Assert.Contains("&lt;<span class=\"hl-tag\">script</span>&gt;", html);
    }
}

using Bunit;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Components;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests.Services;
using Xunit;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests.Components;

public class MasterDetailTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly BunitContext _ctx = new();

    private const string SampleProductsJson = """
        [
          { "name": "Widget A", "category": "Tools", "price": 9.99, "stock": 100, "rating": 4.5, "description": "A widget" },
          { "name": "Gadget B", "category": "Electronics", "price": 49.99, "stock": 25, "rating": 3.8, "description": "A gadget" }
        ]
        """;

    private void SetupServices()
    {
        var fakeHandler = new MasterDetailFakeHttpHandler(SampleProductsJson);
        var httpClient = new HttpClient(fakeHandler) { BaseAddress = new Uri("https://test.local/") };
        _ctx.Services.AddSingleton(httpClient);
        _ctx.Services.AddSingleton<IAnalyticsService>(new NoOpAnalyticsService());

        // bUnit provides JSInterop mocking automatically.
        // Set up the localStorage calls the component makes.
        _ctx.JSInterop.SetupVoid("localStorage.setItem", _ => true);
        _ctx.JSInterop.SetupVoid("localStorage.removeItem", _ => true);
        _ctx.JSInterop.Setup<string?>("localStorage.getItem", _ => true).SetResult(null);
    }

    [Fact]

FILE: tests/ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests/Components/QuizQuestionCardTests.cs
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
using Bunit;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Components;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Models;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests.Services;
using Xunit;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests.Components;

public class QuizQuestionCardTests : IDisposable
{
    private readonly BunitContext _ctx = new();

    private IRenderedComponent<QuizQuestionCard> Render(QuizQuestion question, Action<QuizAnswer>? onAnswered = null, QuestionProgress? initial = null) =>
        _ctx.Render<QuizQuestionCard>(p => p
            .Add(c => c.Question, question)
            .Add(c => c.Number, 1)
            .Add(c => c.InitialProgress, initial)
            .Add(c => c.OnAnswered, onAnswered ?? (_ => { })));

    [Fact]
    public void SingleChoice_RendersRadioButtons()
    {
        var cut = Render(BookTestData.SingleChoice());

        Assert.Equal(3, cut.FindAll("input[type=radio]").Count);
        Assert.Contains("Select one answer", cut.Markup);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MultipleChoice_RendersCheckboxes()
    {
        var cut = Render(BookTestData.MultipleChoice());

        Assert.Equal(3, cut.FindAll("input[type=checkbox]").Count);
        Assert.Contains("Select all that apply", cut.Markup);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SubmitButton_DisabledUntilSelection()
    {
        var cut = Render(BookTestData.SingleChoice());

        Assert.True(cut.Find(".quiz-submit").HasAttribute("disabled"));

        cut.Find("input[value=b]").Change("b");

        Assert.False(cut.Find(".quiz-submit").HasAttribute("disabled"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CorrectSingleAnswer_ShowsSuccessAndExplanation()
    {
        QuizAnswer? answer = null;
        var cut = Render(BookTestData.SingleChoice(), a => answer = a);

        cut.Find("input[value=b]").Change("b");
        cut.Find(".quiz-submit").Click();

        Assert.NotNull(answer);
        Assert.True(answer.Result.IsCorrect);
        Assert.Contains("Correct!", cut.Markup);
        Assert.Contains("Because B.", cut.Markup);
        Assert.Empty(cut.FindAll(".quiz-retry"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PartialMultipleAnswer_ShowsRetryAndHidesSolution()
    {
        QuizAnswer? answer = null;
        var cut = Render(BookTestData.MultipleChoice(), a => answer = a);

        cut.Find("input[value=a]").Change(true);
        cut.Find(".quiz-submit").Click();

        Assert.False(answer!.Result.IsCorrect);
        Assert.Contains("Not quite.", cut.Markup);
        Assert.Empty(cut.FindAll(".quiz-option.is-answer"));
        Assert.NotNull(cut.Find(".quiz-retry"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Reveal_HighlightsAllCorrectOptions()
    {
        var cut = Render(BookTestData.MultipleChoice());

        cut.Find("input[value=b]").Change(true);
        cut.Find(".quiz-submit").Click();
        cut.Find(".quiz-reveal").Click();

        Assert.Equal(2, cut.FindAll(".quiz-option.is-answer").Count);
        Assert.Single(cut.FindAll(".quiz-option.is-wrong"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Retry_ClearsSelectionAndResult()
    {
        var cut = Render(BookTestData.SingleChoice());

        cut.Find("input[value=a]").Change("a");
        cut.Find(".quiz-submit").Click();
        cut.Find(".quiz-retry").Click();

        Assert.DoesNotContain("Not quite.", cut.Markup);
        Assert.True(cut.Find(".quiz-submit").HasAttribute("disabled"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PreviouslyCorrectAnswer_IsRestored()
    {
        var initial = new QuestionProgress
        {
            Attempts = 2,
            AnsweredCorrectly = true,
            LastAttemptCorrect = true,
            LastSelection = ["b"]
        };

        var cut = Render(BookTestData.SingleChoice(), initial: initial);

        Assert.Contains("Correct!", cut.Markup);
        Assert.Contains("2 attempts", cut.Markup);
    }

    public void Dispose() => _ctx.Dispose();
}

          { "name": "Gadget B", "category": "Electronics", "price": 49.99, "stock": 25, "rating": 3.8, "description": "A gadget" }

FILE: tests/ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests/Components/ShowcaseTests.cs
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
using System.Text.Json;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Models;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;
using Xunit;
using static ObserverMagazine.Web.Pages.Showcase;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests.Components;

/// <summary>
/// Tests for the Showcase page logic: ProductDataGenerator, ColumnDef, FilterKind,
/// ShowcasePrefs serialization, and filtering/sorting/pagination helpers.
/// </summary>
public class ProductDataGeneratorTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Generate_ReturnsRequestedCount()
    {
        var products = ProductDataGenerator.Generate(100);
        Assert.Equal(100, products.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_DefaultCountIs20_000()
    {
        var products = ProductDataGenerator.Generate();
        Assert.Equal(20_000, products.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_SkusAreUnique()
    {
        var products = ProductDataGenerator.Generate(500);
        var uniqueSkus = products.Select(p => p.Sku).Distinct().Count();
        Assert.Equal(500, uniqueSkus);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_IdsAreUnique()
    {
        var products = ProductDataGenerator.Generate(500);
        var uniqueIds = products.Select(p => p.Id).Distinct().Count();
        Assert.Equal(500, uniqueIds);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_AllProductsHaveRequiredFields()
    {
        var products = ProductDataGenerator.Generate(200);
        foreach (var p in products)
        {
            Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p.Sku), "SKU should not be empty");
            Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p.Name), "Name should not be empty");
            Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p.Brand), "Brand should not be empty");
            Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p.Category), "Category should not be empty");
            Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p.Color), "Color should not be empty");
            Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p.Status), "Status should not be empty");
            Assert.True(p.Price > 0, "Price should be positive");
            Assert.True(p.Rating >= 2.5 && p.Rating <= 5.0, "Rating should be between 2.5 and 5.0");
            Assert.True(p.Stock >= 0, "Stock should be non-negative");
            Assert.NotEqual(default, p.DateAdded);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_HasVarietyOfBrands()
    {
        var products = ProductDataGenerator.Generate(500);
        var uniqueBrands = products.Select(p => p.Brand).Distinct().Count();
        Assert.True(uniqueBrands >= 5, $"Expected at least 5 brands but got {uniqueBrands}");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_HasVarietyOfCategories()
    {
        var products = ProductDataGenerator.Generate(500);
        var uniqueCategories = products.Select(p => p.Category).Distinct().Count();
        Assert.True(uniqueCategories >= 3, $"Expected at least 3 categories but got {uniqueCategories}");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_DeterministicWithSameSeed()
    {
        var products1 = ProductDataGenerator.Generate(50, seed: 42);
        var products2 = ProductDataGenerator.Generate(50, seed: 42);

        for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++)
        {
            Assert.Equal(products1[i].Id, products2[i].Id);
            Assert.Equal(products1[i].Sku, products2[i].Sku);
            Assert.Equal(products1[i].Name, products2[i].Name);
            Assert.Equal(products1[i].Price, products2[i].Price);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_DifferentSeedsProduceDifferentData()
    {
        var products1 = ProductDataGenerator.Generate(50, seed: 1);
        var products2 = ProductDataGenerator.Generate(50, seed: 999);

        // At least some products should differ
        var differentCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++)
        {
            if (products1[i].Name != products2[i].Name) differentCount++;
        }
        Assert.True(differentCount > 10, $"Expected significant differences but only {differentCount} of 50 were different");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_StatusesAreValid()
    {
        var validStatuses = new HashSet<string> { "Active", "Draft", "Archived", "Out of Stock" };
        var products = ProductDataGenerator.Generate(200);
        foreach (var p in products)
        {
            Assert.Contains(p.Status, validStatuses);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generate_CompareAtPriceIsHigherWhenPresent()
    {
        var products = ProductDataGenerator.Generate(500);
        foreach (var p in products.Where(p => p.CompareAtPrice.HasValue))
        {
            Assert.True(p.CompareAtPrice!.Value > p.Price,
                $"CompareAtPrice ({p.CompareAtPrice}) should be higher than Price ({p.Price})");
        }
    }
}

public class ColumnDefTests

    }
