/// <summary>
/// Tests for ShowcasePrefs serialization round-trip.
/// </summary>
public class ShowcasePrefsTests
{
    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions JsonOpts = new()
    {
        PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase
    };

    [Fact]
    public void ShowcasePrefs_RoundTrip_AllFields()
    {
        var prefs = new ShowcasePrefs
        {
            PageSize = 50,
            SortColumn = "Price",
            SortAsc = false,
            ShowFilters = true,
            ColumnVisibility = new Dictionary<string, bool>
            {
                ["Sku"] = true,
                ["Name"] = true,
                ["Brand"] = false,
                ["Color"] = false,
            },
            Filters = new Dictionary<string, FilterState>
            {
                ["Name"] = new() { Text = "keyboard" },
                ["Price"] = new() { Min = "10", Max = "500" },
                ["Category"] = new() { Text = "Electronics" },
            }
        };

        var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(prefs, JsonOpts);
        Assert.False(string.IsNullOrEmpty(json));

        var deserialized = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ShowcasePrefs>(json, JsonOpts);
        Assert.NotNull(deserialized);
        Assert.Equal(50, deserialized.PageSize);
        Assert.Equal("Price", deserialized.SortColumn);
        Assert.False(deserialized.SortAsc);
        Assert.True(deserialized.ShowFilters);
        Assert.Equal(4, deserialized.ColumnVisibility!.Count);
        Assert.False(deserialized.ColumnVisibility["Brand"]);
        Assert.Equal(3, deserialized.Filters!.Count);
        Assert.Equal("keyboard", deserialized.Filters["Name"].Text);
        Assert.Equal("10", deserialized.Filters["Price"].Min);
        Assert.Equal("500", deserialized.Filters["Price"].Max);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ShowcasePrefs_RoundTrip_Empty()
    {
        var prefs = new ShowcasePrefs();
        var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(prefs, JsonOpts);
        var deserialized = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ShowcasePrefs>(json, JsonOpts);

        Assert.NotNull(deserialized);
        Assert.Null(deserialized.PageSize);
        Assert.Null(deserialized.SortColumn);
        Assert.Null(deserialized.SortAsc);
        Assert.Null(deserialized.ShowFilters);
        Assert.Null(deserialized.ColumnVisibility);
        Assert.Null(deserialized.Filters);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ShowcasePrefs_DeserializeFromPartialJson()
    {
        // Only page size set — rest should be null
        var json = """{"pageSize":100}""";
        var prefs = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ShowcasePrefs>(json, JsonOpts);

        Assert.NotNull(prefs);
        Assert.Equal(100, prefs.PageSize);
        Assert.Null(prefs.SortColumn);
        Assert.Null(prefs.Filters);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FilterState_RoundTrip()
    {
        var fs = new FilterState { Text = "test", Min = "5", Max = "100" };
        var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(fs, JsonOpts);
        var deserialized = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<FilterState>(json, JsonOpts);

        Assert.NotNull(deserialized);
        Assert.Equal("test", deserialized.Text);
        Assert.Equal("5", deserialized.Min);
        Assert.Equal("100", deserialized.Max);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void FilterState_NullFields_Serialize()
    {
        var fs = new FilterState { Text = null, Min = null, Max = null };
        var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(fs, JsonOpts);
        var deserialized = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<FilterState>(json, JsonOpts);

        Assert.NotNull(deserialized);
        Assert.Null(deserialized.Text);
        Assert.Null(deserialized.Min);
        Assert.Null(deserialized.Max);
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Tests for filtering, sorting, and pagination logic extracted into testable helpers.
/// These test the same algorithms used by Showcase.razor's @code block.
/// </summary>
public class ShowcaseFilterSortTests
{
    private static List<CatalogProduct> CreateTestProducts()
    {
        return
        [
            new()
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(), Sku = "SKU-001", Name = "Wireless Mouse", Brand = "TechCo",
                Category = "Electronics", Price = 29.99m, Stock = 150, Rating = 4.2,
                ReviewCount = 340, WeightKg = 0.12, Color = "Black", WarrantyMonths = 12,
                DateAdded = new DateTime(2025, 6, 15), Status = "Active",
                Description = "A wireless mouse by TechCo."
            },
            new()
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(), Sku = "SKU-002", Name = "Standing Desk", Brand = "ErgoFit",
                Category = "Furniture", Price = 499.00m, Stock = 25, Rating = 4.8,
                ReviewCount = 120, WeightKg = 35.0, Color = "White", WarrantyMonths = 36,
                DateAdded = new DateTime(2025, 3, 10), Status = "Active",
                Description = "A standing desk by ErgoFit."
            },
            new()
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(), Sku = "SKU-003", Name = "Desk Mat XL", Brand = "WorkSpace",
                Category = "Accessories", Price = 34.50m, Stock = 500, Rating = 4.0,
                ReviewCount = 89, WeightKg = 0.8, Color = "Gray", WarrantyMonths = 0,
                DateAdded = new DateTime(2025, 9, 22), Status = "Draft",
                Description = "An XL desk mat."
            },
            new()
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(), Sku = "SKU-004", Name = "Keyboard Pro", Brand = "TechCo",
                Category = "Electronics", Price = 149.99m, Stock = 0, Rating = 4.5,
                ReviewCount = 700, WeightKg = 0.9, Color = "Black", WarrantyMonths = 24,
                DateAdded = new DateTime(2024, 12, 1), Status = "Out of Stock",
                Description = "A mechanical keyboard by TechCo."
            },
            new()
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(), Sku = "SKU-005", Name = "Monitor Arm", Brand = "ErgoFit",
                Category = "Accessories", Price = 89.00m, Stock = 200, Rating = 3.9,
                ReviewCount = 55, WeightKg = 3.2, Color = "Silver", WarrantyMonths = 12,
                DateAdded = new DateTime(2025, 1, 5), Status = "Active",
                Description = "A monitor arm by ErgoFit."
            },
        ];
    }

    // --- Text filter tests ---

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByName_ContainsMatch()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products.Where(p => p.Name.Contains("desk", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(2, filtered.Count); // "Standing Desk" and "Desk Mat XL"
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByName_PartialMatch()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products.Where(p => p.Name.Contains("at", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
        Assert.Single(filtered);
        Assert.Equal("Desk Mat XL", filtered[0].Name);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByBrand_CaseInsensitive()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products.Where(p => p.Brand.Contains("techco", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(2, filtered.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByCategory_ExactMatch()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products.Where(p => p.Category.Equals("Electronics", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(2, filtered.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByStatus_ExactMatch()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products.Where(p => p.Status.Equals("Active", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(3, filtered.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByColor()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products.Where(p => p.Color.Contains("black", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(2, filtered.Count);
    }

    // --- Range filter tests ---

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByPriceMin()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products.Where(p => (double)p.Price >= 50.0).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(3, filtered.Count); // 499, 149.99, 89
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByPriceMax()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products.Where(p => (double)p.Price <= 35.0).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(2, filtered.Count); // 29.99, 34.50
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByPriceRange()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products
            .Where(p => (double)p.Price >= 30.0 && (double)p.Price <= 100.0)
            .ToList();
        Assert.Equal(2, filtered.Count); // 34.50, 89
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByStockMin_GreaterOrEqual()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products.Where(p => p.Stock >= 100).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(3, filtered.Count); // 150, 500, 200
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByRatingMin()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products.Where(p => p.Rating >= 4.5).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(2, filtered.Count); // 4.8, 4.5
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByWarrantyRange()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products.Where(p => p.WarrantyMonths >= 12 && p.WarrantyMonths <= 24).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(3, filtered.Count); // 12, 24, 12
    }

    // --- Combined filters ---

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_CombinedTextAndRange()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products
            .Where(p => p.Brand.Contains("TechCo", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Where(p => (double)p.Price >= 100.0)
            .ToList();
        Assert.Single(filtered);
        Assert.Equal("Keyboard Pro", filtered[0].Name);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_NoMatch_ReturnsEmpty()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products.Where(p => p.Name.Contains("zzzznonexistent", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList();
        Assert.Empty(filtered);
    }

    // --- Sort tests ---

    [Fact]
    public void Sort_ByName_Ascending()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var sorted = products.OrderBy(p => p.Name).ToList();
        Assert.Equal("Desk Mat XL", sorted[0].Name);
        Assert.Equal("Wireless Mouse", sorted[^1].Name);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Sort_ByPrice_Descending()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var sorted = products.OrderByDescending(p => p.Price).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(499.00m, sorted[0].Price);
        Assert.Equal(29.99m, sorted[^1].Price);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Sort_ByRating_Ascending()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var sorted = products.OrderBy(p => p.Rating).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(3.9, sorted[0].Rating);
        Assert.Equal(4.8, sorted[^1].Rating);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Sort_ByStock_Descending()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var sorted = products.OrderByDescending(p => p.Stock).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(500, sorted[0].Stock);
        Assert.Equal(0, sorted[^1].Stock);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Sort_ByDateAdded_Ascending()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var sorted = products.OrderBy(p => p.DateAdded).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(new DateTime(2024, 12, 1), sorted[0].DateAdded);
    }

    // --- Pagination tests ---

    [Fact]
    public void Paginate_FirstPage()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var pageSize = 2;
        var page = products.Skip(0).Take(pageSize).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(2, page.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Paginate_SecondPage()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var pageSize = 2;
        var page = products.Skip(2).Take(pageSize).ToList();
        Assert.Equal(2, page.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Paginate_LastPage_Partial()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts(); // 5 items
        var pageSize = 2;
        var page = products.Skip(4).Take(pageSize).ToList();
        Assert.Single(page);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Paginate_TotalPages_Calculation()
    {
        var count = 5;
        var pageSize = 2;
        var totalPages = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(count / (double)pageSize));
        Assert.Equal(3, totalPages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Paginate_SinglePage()
    {
        var count = 3;
        var pageSize = 10;
        var totalPages = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(count / (double)pageSize));
        Assert.Equal(1, totalPages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Paginate_EmptyList()
    {
        var count = 0;
        var pageSize = 20;
        var totalPages = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(count / (double)pageSize));
        Assert.Equal(1, totalPages); // Still page 1 even with no items
    }

    // --- DateAdded text filter ---

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByDateText_PartialYear()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products
            .Where(p => p.DateAdded.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd").Contains("2025", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .ToList();
        Assert.Equal(4, filtered.Count); // All except the 2024-12-01 one
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Filter_ByDateText_SpecificMonth()
    {
        var products = CreateTestProducts();
        var filtered = products
            .Where(p => p.DateAdded.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd").Contains("2025-06", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .ToList();
        Assert.Single(filtered);
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Simple fake HTTP handler for unit testing without external dependencies.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class FakeHttpHandler : HttpMessageHandler
{
    private readonly HttpResponseMessage _response;

    public FakeHttpHandler(string content, string mediaType)
    {
        _response = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
        {
            Content = new StringContent(content, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8, mediaType)
        };
    }

    public FakeHttpHandler(HttpStatusCode statusCode)
    {
        _response = new HttpResponseMessage(statusCode);
    }

    protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(
        HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(_response);
    }
}

FILE: tests/ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests/Services/BookProgressCalculatorTests.cs
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Models;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;
using Xunit;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests.Services;

public class BookProgressCalculatorTests
{
    private static readonly DateTimeOffset Now = new(2026, 11, 7, 12, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

    private static BookProgress ProgressWith(params (string Key, SubchapterProgress Progress)[] entries)
    {
        var progress = new BookProgress { BookSlug = "sample-book", StartedAt = Now };
        foreach (var (key, sub) in entries)
        {
            progress.Subchapters[key] = sub;
        }
        return progress;
    }

    private static SubchapterProgress Visited(params string[] correctQuestionIds)
    {
        var sub = new SubchapterProgress { FirstVisitedAt = Now, LastVisitedAt = Now };
        foreach (var id in correctQuestionIds)
        {
            sub.Questions[id] = new QuestionProgress { Attempts = 1, AnsweredCorrectly = true, LastAttemptCorrect = true };
        }
        return sub;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetCompletion_NoProgress_IsZero()
    {
        var completion = BookProgressCalculator.GetCompletion(BookTestData.Toc(), null);

        Assert.Equal(0, completion.CompletedSubchapters);
        Assert.Equal(3, completion.TotalSubchapters);
        Assert.Equal(3, completion.TotalQuestions);
        Assert.Equal(0, completion.Percent);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SubchapterWithoutQuestions_CompletesOnVisit()
    {
        var progress = ProgressWith(("intro/reading", Visited()));
        var location = BookNavigator.Find(BookTestData.Toc(), "intro", "reading")!;

        Assert.Equal(SubchapterStatus.Completed, BookProgressCalculator.GetStatus(location, progress));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SubchapterWithQuestions_InProgressUntilAllCorrect()
    {
        var toc = BookTestData.Toc();
        var location = BookNavigator.Find(toc, "intro", "hello")!;

        var partial = ProgressWith(("intro/hello", Visited("q1")));
        var complete = ProgressWith(("intro/hello", Visited("q1", "q2")));

        Assert.Equal(SubchapterStatus.InProgress, BookProgressCalculator.GetStatus(location, partial));
        Assert.Equal(SubchapterStatus.Completed, BookProgressCalculator.GetStatus(location, complete));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetCompletion_PercentRoundsDown()
    {
        var progress = ProgressWith(("intro/reading", Visited()), ("intro/hello", Visited("q1", "q2")));

        var completion = BookProgressCalculator.GetCompletion(BookTestData.Toc(), progress);

        Assert.Equal(2, completion.CompletedSubchapters);
        Assert.Equal(66, completion.Percent);
        Assert.Equal(2, completion.CorrectQuestions);
        Assert.False(completion.IsComplete);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetContinueLocation_NoProgress_ReturnsFirstSection()
    {
        var location = BookProgressCalculator.GetContinueLocation(BookTestData.Toc(), null);

        Assert.NotNull(location);
        Assert.Equal("1.1", location.Label);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetContinueLocation_ReturnsLastVisitedWhenIncomplete()
    {
        var progress = ProgressWith(("deeper/details", Visited()));
        progress.LastChapterSlug = "deeper";
        progress.LastSubchapterSlug = "details";

        var location = BookProgressCalculator.GetContinueLocation(BookTestData.Toc(), progress);

        Assert.Equal("2.1", location!.Label);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetContinueLocation_SkipsCompletedSections()
    {
        var progress = ProgressWith(("intro/hello", Visited("q1", "q2")));
        progress.LastChapterSlug = "intro";
        progress.LastSubchapterSlug = "hello";

        var location = BookProgressCalculator.GetContinueLocation(BookTestData.Toc(), progress);

        Assert.Equal("1.2", location!.Label);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Navigator_GetNeighbors_CrossesChapterBoundaries()
    {
        var toc = BookTestData.Toc();
        var current = BookNavigator.Find(toc, "intro", "reading")!;

        var neighbors = BookNavigator.GetNeighbors(toc, current);

        Assert.Equal("1.1", neighbors.Previous!.Label);
        Assert.Equal("2.1", neighbors.Next!.Label);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Navigator_GetNeighbors_AtEdges()
    {
        var toc = BookTestData.Toc();

        var first = BookNavigator.GetNeighbors(toc, BookNavigator.Find(toc, "intro", "hello")!);
        var last = BookNavigator.GetNeighbors(toc, BookNavigator.Find(toc, "deeper", "details")!);

        Assert.Null(first.Previous);
        Assert.Null(last.Next);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Navigator_Find_IsCaseInsensitiveAndReturnsNullForUnknown()
    {
        var toc = BookTestData.Toc();

        Assert.NotNull(BookNavigator.Find(toc, "INTRO", "Hello"));
        Assert.Null(BookNavigator.Find(toc, "intro", "missing"));
    }
}

FILE: tests/ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests/Services/BookServiceTests.cs

using System.Net;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;
using Xunit;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests.Services;

public class BookServiceTests
{
    private const string IndexJson = """
        [
          { "slug": "older", "title": "Older", "date": "2026-01-01T00:00:00", "chapterCount": 1 },
          { "slug": "newer", "title": "Newer", "date": "2026-06-01T00:00:00", "chapterCount": 2 }
        ]
        """;

    private const string TocJson = """
        {
          "slug": "newer",
          "title": "Newer",
          "chapters": [
            { "number": 1, "slug": "intro", "title": "Intro",
              "subchapters": [ { "number": 1, "slug": "hello", "title": "Hello", "questionIds": ["q1"] } ] }
          ]
        }
        """;

    private const string SubchapterJson = """
        {
          "bookSlug": "newer", "chapterSlug": "intro", "slug": "hello", "title": "Hello",
          "chapterNumber": 1, "number": 1, "html": "<p>Hi</p>",
          "questions": [
            { "id": "q1", "promptHtml": "<p>?</p>", "multipleAnswers": true,
              "options": [ { "id": "a", "textHtml": "A", "correct": true }, { "id": "b", "textHtml": "B" } ] }
          ]
        }
        """;

    private static (BookService Service, RoutingHttpHandler Handler) Create(Dictionary<string, string> routes)
    {
        var handler = new RoutingHttpHandler(routes);
        var http = new HttpClient(handler) { BaseAddress = new Uri("https://test.local/") };
        return (new BookService(http, NullLogger<BookService>.Instance), handler);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetBooksAsync_ReturnsBooksNewestFirst()
    {
        var (service, _) = Create(new() { ["/book-data/books-index.json"] = IndexJson });

        var books = await service.GetBooksAsync();

        Assert.Equal(["newer", "older"], books.Select(b => b.Slug).ToArray());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetBooksAsync_MissingIndex_ReturnsEmptyAndRetriesLater()
    {
        var (service, handler) = Create(new());

        Assert.Empty(await service.GetBooksAsync());
        Assert.Empty(await service.GetBooksAsync());
        Assert.Equal(2, handler.Requests.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetBooksAsync_InvalidJson_ReturnsEmpty()
    {
        var (service, _) = Create(new() { ["/book-data/books-index.json"] = "<html>not json</html>" });

        Assert.Empty(await service.GetBooksAsync());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetTocAsync_IsCached()
    {
        var (service, handler) = Create(new() { ["/book-data/newer/toc.json"] = TocJson });

        var first = await service.GetTocAsync("newer");
        var second = await service.GetTocAsync("NEWER");

        Assert.NotNull(first);
        Assert.Same(first, second);
        Assert.Single(handler.Requests);
        Assert.Equal(["q1"], first.Chapters[0].Subchapters[0].QuestionIds);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetSubchapterAsync_DeserializesQuestions()
    {
        var (service, _) = Create(new() { ["/book-data/newer/intro/hello.json"] = SubchapterJson });

        var content = await service.GetSubchapterAsync("newer", "intro", "hello");

        Assert.NotNull(content);
        var question = Assert.Single(content.Questions);
        Assert.True(question.MultipleAnswers);
        Assert.Equal(2, question.Options.Length);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("../secrets")]
    [InlineData("has space")]
    [InlineData("")]
    public async Task InvalidSlugs_ReturnNullWithoutRequests(string slug)
    {
        var (service, handler) = Create(new());

        Assert.Null(await service.GetTocAsync(slug));
        Assert.Null(await service.GetSubchapterAsync("newer", slug, "hello"));
        Assert.Empty(handler.Requests);
    }
}

internal sealed class RoutingHttpHandler(Dictionary<string, string> routes) : HttpMessageHandler
{
    public List<string> Requests { get; } = [];

    protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var path = request.RequestUri?.AbsolutePath ?? "";
        Requests.Add(path);

        var response = routes.TryGetValue(path, out var body)
            ? new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
            {
                Content = new StringContent(body, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8, "application/json")
            }
            : new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);

        return Task.FromResult(response);
    }
}

FILE: tests/ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests/Services/FallbackProgressStoreTests.cs
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;
using Xunit;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests.Services;

public class FallbackProgressStoreTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task HealthyPrimary_IsUsed()
    {
        var primary = new InMemoryProgressStore();
        var fallback = new InMemoryProgressStore();
        var store = new FallbackProgressStore(primary, fallback, NullLogger<FallbackProgressStore>.Instance);

        await store.SetAsync("k", "v");

        Assert.Equal("v", await primary.GetAsync("k"));
        Assert.Null(await fallback.GetAsync("k"));
        Assert.False(store.IsUsingFallback);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task FailingPrimary_SwitchesToFallbackPermanently()
    {
        var primary = new ThrowingProgressStore();
        var fallback = new InMemoryProgressStore();
        var store = new FallbackProgressStore(primary, fallback, NullLogger<FallbackProgressStore>.Instance);

        await store.SetAsync("k", "v");
        var value = await store.GetAsync("k");
        var persistent = await store.IsPersistentAsync();

        Assert.Equal("v", value);
        Assert.False(persistent);
        Assert.True(store.IsUsingFallback);
        Assert.Equal(1, primary.Calls);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task RemoveAsync_WorksOnFallback()
    {
        var store = new FallbackProgressStore(new ThrowingProgressStore(), new InMemoryProgressStore(), NullLogger<FallbackProgressStore>.Instance);

        await store.SetAsync("k", "v");
        await store.RemoveAsync("k");

        Assert.Null(await store.GetAsync("k"));
    }
}

    {

public class QuizEvaluatorTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void SingleChoice_CorrectOption_IsCorrect()
    {
        var result = QuizEvaluator.Evaluate(BookTestData.SingleChoice(), ["b"]);

        Assert.True(result.IsCorrect);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SingleChoice_WrongOption_IsIncorrectAndFlagged()
    {
        var result = QuizEvaluator.Evaluate(BookTestData.SingleChoice(), ["a"]);

        Assert.False(result.IsCorrect);
        Assert.True(result.IsWronglySelected("a"));
        Assert.False(result.IsWronglySelected("b"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SingleChoice_MoreThanOneSelection_IsIncorrect()
    {
        var result = QuizEvaluator.Evaluate(BookTestData.SingleChoice(), ["a", "b"]);

        Assert.False(result.IsCorrect);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MultipleChoice_AllCorrectOptions_IsCorrect()
    {
        var result = QuizEvaluator.Evaluate(BookTestData.MultipleChoice(), ["c", "a"]);

        Assert.True(result.IsCorrect);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MultipleChoice_PartialSelection_IsIncorrect()
    {
        var result = QuizEvaluator.Evaluate(BookTestData.MultipleChoice(), ["a"]);

        Assert.False(result.IsCorrect);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MultipleChoice_ExtraWrongOption_IsIncorrect()
    {
        var result = QuizEvaluator.Evaluate(BookTestData.MultipleChoice(), ["a", "b", "c"]);

        Assert.False(result.IsCorrect);
        Assert.True(result.IsWronglySelected("b"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void UnknownOptionIds_AreIgnored()
    {
        var result = QuizEvaluator.Evaluate(BookTestData.SingleChoice(), ["b", "zzz"]);

        Assert.True(result.IsCorrect);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("zzz", result.Selected);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EmptySelection_IsIncorrect()
    {
        var result = QuizEvaluator.Evaluate(BookTestData.MultipleChoice(), []);

        Assert.False(result.IsCorrect);
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using ObserverMagazine.Web.Services;
using Xunit;

namespace ObserverMagazine.Web.Tests.Services;

public class ReadingProgressServiceTests
{
    private static readonly DateTimeOffset Start = new(2026, 11, 7, 12, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

    private static ReadingProgressService CreateService(IProgressStore store, FakeTimeProvider? time = null) =>
        new(store, time ?? new FakeTimeProvider(Start), NullLogger<ReadingProgressService>.Instance);

    [Fact]
    public async Task GetAsync_NoStoredData_ReturnsFreshProgress()
    {
        using var service = CreateService(new InMemoryProgressStore());

        var progress = await service.GetAsync("book");

        Assert.Equal("book", progress.BookSlug);
        Assert.False(progress.IsStarted);
        Assert.Empty(progress.Subchapters);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task RecordVisitAsync_FlagsFirstVisitsOnlyOnce()
    {
        using var service = CreateService(new InMemoryProgressStore());

        var first = await service.RecordVisitAsync("book", "ch", "a");
        var second = await service.RecordVisitAsync("book", "ch", "a");
        var other = await service.RecordVisitAsync("book", "ch", "b");

        Assert.True(first.IsFirstVisitToBook);
        Assert.True(first.IsFirstVisitToSubchapter);
        Assert.False(second.IsFirstVisitToBook);
        Assert.False(second.IsFirstVisitToSubchapter);
        Assert.False(other.IsFirstVisitToBook);
        Assert.True(other.IsFirstVisitToSubchapter);
        Assert.Equal("b", other.Progress.LastSubchapterSlug);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task RecordAnswerAsync_CorrectnessIsSticky()
    {
        using var service = CreateService(new InMemoryProgressStore());

        await service.RecordAnswerAsync("book", "ch", "a", "q1", ["x"], isCorrect: true);
        var progress = await service.RecordAnswerAsync("book", "ch", "a", "q1", ["y"], isCorrect: false);

        var question = progress.Subchapters["ch/a"].Questions["q1"];
        Assert.Equal(2, question.Attempts);
        Assert.True(question.AnsweredCorrectly);
        Assert.False(question.LastAttemptCorrect);
        Assert.Equal(["y"], question.LastSelection);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Progress_PersistsAcrossServiceInstances()
    {
        var store = new InMemoryProgressStore();
        using (var writer = CreateService(store))
        {
            await writer.RecordVisitAsync("book", "ch", "a");
            await writer.RecordAnswerAsync("book", "ch", "a", "q1", ["x"], isCorrect: true);
        }

        using var reader = CreateService(store);
        var progress = await reader.GetAsync("book");

        Assert.True(progress.IsStarted);
        Assert.Equal<DateTimeOffset?>(Start, progress.StartedAt);
        Assert.True(progress.Subchapters["ch/a"].Questions["q1"].AnsweredCorrectly);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task CorruptStoredData_StartsFresh()
    {
        var store = new InMemoryProgressStore();
        await store.SetAsync(ReadingProgressService.StorageKey("book"), "{ not json");
        using var service = CreateService(store);

        var progress = await service.GetAsync("book");

        Assert.False(progress.IsStarted);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task IncompatibleSchemaVersion_StartsFresh()
    {
        var store = new InMemoryProgressStore();
        await store.SetAsync(ReadingProgressService.StorageKey("book"),
            """{ "schemaVersion": 999, "bookSlug": "book", "startedAt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z" }""");
        using var service = CreateService(store);

        var progress = await service.GetAsync("book");

        Assert.False(progress.IsStarted);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task NullCollectionsInStoredData_AreNormalized()
    {
        var store = new InMemoryProgressStore();
        await store.SetAsync(ReadingProgressService.StorageKey("book"),
            """{ "schemaVersion": 1, "bookSlug": "book", "subchapters": { "ch/a": { "questions": null } } }""");
        using var service = CreateService(store);

        var progress = await service.GetAsync("book");

        Assert.Empty(progress.Subchapters["ch/a"].Questions);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ResetAsync_ClearsMemoryAndStorage()
    {
        var store = new InMemoryProgressStore();
        using var service = CreateService(store);
        await service.RecordVisitAsync("book", "ch", "a");

        var reset = await service.ResetAsync("book");

        Assert.False(reset.IsStarted);
        Assert.Null(await store.GetAsync(ReadingProgressService.StorageKey("book")));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task FailingStore_DoesNotThrow()
    {
        using var service = CreateService(new ThrowingProgressStore());

        var visit = await service.RecordVisitAsync("book", "ch", "a");
        var persistent = await service.IsPersistentAsync();

        Assert.True(visit.IsFirstVisitToBook);
        Assert.False(persistent);
    }
}

internal sealed class ThrowingProgressStore : IProgressStore
{
    public int Calls { get; private set; }

    public ValueTask<string?> GetAsync(string key) => Fail<string?>();
    public ValueTask SetAsync(string key, string value) => new(Fail<bool>().AsTask());
    public ValueTask RemoveAsync(string key) => new(Fail<bool>().AsTask());
    public ValueTask<bool> IsPersistentAsync() => Fail<bool>();

    private ValueTask<T> Fail<T>()
    {
        Calls++;
        return ValueTask.FromException<T>(new InvalidOperationException("storage unavailable"));
    }
}

FILE: tools/generate_audio.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Generate MP3 audio files from blog post markdown using KittenTTS.

Usage:
    python tools/generate_audio.py --content-dir content/blog --output-dir src/ObserverMagazine.Web/wwwroot/blog-data

Requires:
    - KittenTTS 0.8.1 (pip install from GitHub releases)
    - espeak-ng (apt install espeak-ng)
    - ffmpeg (for WAV → MP3 conversion)
    - soundfile, num2words

The script:
    1. Reads each .md file from content-dir
    2. Strips YAML front matter and markdown formatting → plain text
    3. Generates speech audio with KittenTTS (nano model, CPU-only, ~25MB)
    4. Converts WAV → MP3 at 24kbps mono via ffmpeg (keeps files small)
    5. Skips regeneration if the content hash matches the manifest
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Content-hash manifest for incremental builds
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

MANIFEST_FILENAME = "audio-manifest.json"


def compute_content_hash(filepath: str) -> str:
    """Compute SHA256 hash of file content for change detection."""
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(filepath, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def load_manifest(output_dir: str) -> dict:
    """Load the audio manifest from the output directory."""
    manifest_path = os.path.join(output_dir, MANIFEST_FILENAME)
    if os.path.exists(manifest_path):
        try:
            with open(manifest_path) as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as e:
            print(f"  WARNING: Could not load manifest: {e}")
    return {}


def save_manifest(output_dir: str, manifest: dict) -> None:
    """Save the audio manifest to the output directory."""
    manifest_path = os.path.join(output_dir, MANIFEST_FILENAME)
    with open(manifest_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(manifest, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
    print(f"Wrote audio manifest: {manifest_path} ({len(manifest)} entries)")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Text extraction
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def strip_front_matter(content: str) -> str:
    """Remove YAML front matter delimited by --- ... ---"""
    if not content.startswith("---"):
        return content
    end = content.find("---", 3)
    if end < 0:
        return content
    return content[end + 3:].strip()


def strip_markdown(text: str) -> str:
    """Convert markdown to plain text suitable for TTS."""
    # Remove code blocks
    text = re.sub(r"```[\s\S]*?```", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"`[^`]+`", " ", text)

    # Remove images
    text = re.sub(r"!\[.*?\]\(.*?\)", " ", text)

    # Convert links to just their text
    text = re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)", r"\1", text)

    # Remove headers (keep the text)
    text = re.sub(r"^#{1,6}\s+", "", text, flags=re.MULTILINE)

    # Remove bold/italic markers
    text = re.sub(r"\*{1,3}([^*]+)\*{1,3}", r"\1", text)
    text = re.sub(r"_{1,3}([^_]+)_{1,3}", r"\1", text)

    # Remove horizontal rules
    text = re.sub(r"^[-*_]{3,}\s*$", " ", text, flags=re.MULTILINE)

    # Remove HTML tags
    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)

    # Remove blockquote markers
    text = re.sub(r"^>\s*", "", text, flags=re.MULTILINE)

    # Remove list markers
    text = re.sub(r"^[\s]*[-*+]\s+", "", text, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    text = re.sub(r"^[\s]*\d+\.\s+", "", text, flags=re.MULTILINE)

    # Collapse whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\n{2,}", ". ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\n", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s{2,}", " ", text)

    return text.strip()


def preprocess_programming_terms(text: str) -> str:
    """
    Replace programming terms and symbols that TTS engines commonly mispronounce.
    Must run BEFORE preprocess_numbers since some terms contain digits.
    """
    replacements = [
        # Languages and frameworks — order matters (longer matches first)
        (r"\.NET\s+10", "dot net ten"),
        (r"\.NET\s+8", "dot net eight"),
        (r"\.NET\s+7", "dot net seven"),
        (r"\.NET\s+6", "dot net six"),
        (r"\.NET\s+Core\s+3\.0", "dot net core three point oh"),
        (r"\.NET\s+Core", "dot net core"),
        (r"\.NET\s+Framework\s+4\.8", "dot net framework four point eight"),
        (r"\.NET\s+Framework", "dot net framework"),
        (r"\.NET", "dot net"),
        (r"\bC#", "C sharp"),
        (r"\bF#", "F sharp"),
        (r"\bC\+\+", "C plus plus"),
        (r"\bASP\.NET", "asp dot net"),

        # File extensions and config
        (r"\.csproj\b", " C sharp project file"),
        (r"\.cshtml\b", " C S H T M L"),
        (r"\.ascx\b", " A S C X"),
        (r"\.aspx\b", " A S P X"),
        (r"\.slnx\b", " solution X"),
        (r"\.sln\b", " solution"),
        (r"\.json\b", " JSON"),
        (r"\.yml\b", " YAML"),
        (r"\.xml\b", " X M L"),
        (r"\.md\b", " markdown"),
        (r"\.css\b", " C S S"),
        (r"\.js\b", " JavaScript"),
        (r"\.wasm\b", " web assembly"),

        # Common abbreviations
        (r"\bWASM\b", "web assembly"),
        (r"\bIL\b", "intermediate language"),
        (r"\bCLR\b", "common language runtime"),
        (r"\bJIT\b", "just in time"),
        (r"\bAOT\b", "ahead of time"),
        (r"\bNGen\b", "N gen"),
        (r"\bR2R\b", "ready to run"),
        (r"\bDI\b", "dependency injection"),
        (r"\bOWIN\b", "oh win"),
        (r"\bCORS\b", "cross origin resource sharing"),
        (r"\bRSS\b", "R S S"),
        (r"\bAPI\b", "A P I"),
        (r"\bAPIs\b", "A P Is"),
        (r"\bUI\b", "U I"),
        (r"\bUIs\b", "U Is"),
        (r"\bURL\b", "U R L"),
        (r"\bHTTP\b", "H T T P"),
        (r"\bHTTPS\b", "H T T P S"),
        (r"\bHTML\b", "H T M L"),
        (r"\bCSS\b", "C S S"),
        (r"\bSQL\b", "S Q L"),
        (r"\bSSD\b", "S S D"),
        (r"\bSSDs\b", "S S Ds"),
        (r"\bI/O\b", "I O"),
        (r"\bIIS\b", "I I S"),
        (r"\bMVC\b", "M V C"),
        (r"\bLTS\b", "long term support"),
        (r"\bSDK\b", "S D K"),
        (r"\bNuGet\b", "new get"),
        (r"\bxUnit\b", "x unit"),
        (r"\bbUnit\b", "b unit"),

        # Symbols in technical context
        (r"=>", " arrow "),
        (r"!=", " not equal "),
        (r"==", " equals "),
        (r">=", " greater than or equal "),
        (r"<=", " less than or equal "),

        # Version patterns (e.g., "v3", "v6")
        (r"\bv(\d+)\b", r"version \1"),
    ]

    for pattern, replacement in replacements:
        text = re.sub(pattern, replacement, text)

    return text


def preprocess_numbers(text: str) -> str:
    """Convert numbers to words to work around KittenTTS number pronunciation bug."""
    try:
        from num2words import num2words as n2w
    except ImportError:
        print("WARNING: num2words not installed, skipping number conversion")
        return text

    def replace_number(match):
        num_str = match.group(0)
        try:
            # Handle decimals
            if "." in num_str:
                return n2w(float(num_str))
            return n2w(int(num_str))
        except (ValueError, OverflowError):
            return num_str

    # Match numbers (including decimals), but not parts of words
    return re.sub(r"\b\d+\.?\d*\b", replace_number, text)


def derive_slug(filename: str) -> str:
    """Derive slug from filename: 2026-01-15-welcome-post.md → welcome-post"""
    name = os.path.splitext(filename)[0]
    if (len(name) > 11
            and name[4] == "-"
            and name[7] == "-"
            and name[10] == "-"
            and name[:4].isdigit()):
        return name[11:]
    return name


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Audio generation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def chunk_text(text: str, max_chars: int = 500) -> list[str]:
    """
    Split text into chunks for TTS processing.
    KittenTTS works best with shorter segments.
    Splits on sentence boundaries (. ! ?) to maintain natural speech flow.
    """
    sentences = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text)
    chunks = []
    current = ""

    for sentence in sentences:
        if not sentence.strip():
            continue
        if len(current) + len(sentence) + 1 > max_chars and current:
            chunks.append(current.strip())
            current = sentence
        else:
            current = f"{current} {sentence}" if current else sentence

    if current.strip():
        chunks.append(current.strip())

    return chunks if chunks else [text]


def generate_audio(text: str, output_mp3: str, voice: str = "Bella", model_name: str = "KittenML/kitten-tts-nano-0.8") -> bool:
    """
    Generate MP3 audio from text using KittenTTS.

    Steps:
        1. Chunk text into TTS-friendly segments
        2. Generate WAV audio for each chunk
        3. Concatenate chunks
        4. Convert combined WAV → MP3 via ffmpeg at 24kbps mono

    Returns True on success, False on failure.
    """
    import numpy as np
    import soundfile as sf

    try:
        from kittentts import KittenTTS
    except ImportError:
        print("ERROR: kittentts not installed. Run: pip install -r tools/requirements-audio.txt")
        return False

    print(f"  Loading model: {model_name}")
    start = time.time()
    model = KittenTTS(model_name)
    print(f"  Model loaded in {time.time() - start:.1f}s")

    chunks = chunk_text(text)
    print(f"  Processing {len(chunks)} text chunk(s), voice={voice}")

    all_audio = []
    for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
        if not chunk.strip():
            continue
        print(f"    Chunk {i+1}/{len(chunks)}: {len(chunk)} chars")
        try:
            audio = model.generate(chunk, voice=voice, speed=1.15)
            all_audio.append(audio)
            # Add a short silence between chunks (0.3s at 24kHz)
            all_audio.append(np.zeros(int(24000 * 0.3), dtype=np.float32))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"    WARNING: Failed to generate chunk {i+1}: {e}")
            continue

    if not all_audio:
        print("  ERROR: No audio generated")
        return False

    combined = np.concatenate(all_audio)
    duration_sec = len(combined) / 24000
    print(f"  Audio duration: {duration_sec:.1f}s")

    # Write temporary WAV
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False) as tmp:
        tmp_wav = tmp.name
        sf.write(tmp_wav, combined, 24000)

    try:
        # Convert to MP3 using ffmpeg: 24kbps mono (good quality for speech, small file)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_mp3), exist_ok=True)
        result = subprocess.run(
            [
                "ffmpeg", "-y",
                "-i", tmp_wav,
                "-codec:a", "libmp3lame",
                "-b:a", "24k",
                "-ac", "1",          # mono
                "-ar", "24000",      # keep original sample rate
                output_mp3,
            ],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=120,
        )

        if result.returncode != 0:
            print(f"  ERROR: ffmpeg failed:\n{result.stderr}")
            return False

        mp3_size = os.path.getsize(output_mp3)
        mp3_size_mb = mp3_size / (1024 * 1024)
        print(f"  Wrote: {output_mp3} ({mp3_size_mb:.2f} MB, {duration_sec:.1f}s)")

        if mp3_size_mb > 40:
            print(f"  WARNING: File exceeds 40MB limit! ({mp3_size_mb:.1f} MB)")

        return True

    finally:
        os.unlink(tmp_wav)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate TTS audio for blog posts")
    parser.add_argument("--content-dir", default="content/blog", help="Markdown source directory")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", default="src/ObserverMagazine.Web/wwwroot/blog-data", help="Output directory for MP3 files")
    parser.add_argument("--voice", default="Bella", help="KittenTTS voice (Bella, Jasper, Luna, Bruno, Rosie, Hugo, Kiki, Leo)")
    parser.add_argument("--model", default="KittenML/kitten-tts-nano-0.8",
                        help="HuggingFace model ID (nano=25MB/fast, mini=80MB/better quality)")
    parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="Regenerate even if MP3 is up to date")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not os.path.isdir(args.content_dir):
        print(f"Content directory not found: {args.content_dir}")
        sys.exit(1)

    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # Load existing manifest for incremental builds
    manifest = load_manifest(args.output_dir)
    new_manifest = {}

    md_files = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(args.content_dir) if f.endswith(".md"))
    print(f"Found {len(md_files)} markdown file(s) in {args.content_dir}")

    generated = 0
    skipped = 0
    failed = 0

    for md_file in md_files:
        md_path = os.path.join(args.content_dir, md_file)
        slug = derive_slug(md_file)
        mp3_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, f"{slug}.mp3")

        # Compute content hash for change detection
        content_hash = compute_content_hash(md_path)
        old_hash = manifest.get(slug, {}).get("hash")

        # Skip if content unchanged AND MP3 already exists
        if not args.force and os.path.exists(mp3_path) and content_hash == old_hash:
            print(f"  Skipping (unchanged): {slug}.mp3")
            new_manifest[slug] = {"hash": content_hash}
            skipped += 1
            continue

        if content_hash != old_hash:
            reason = "new" if old_hash is None else "modified"
            print(f"\nProcessing ({reason}): {md_file} → {slug}.mp3")
        else:
            print(f"\nProcessing (mp3 missing): {md_file} → {slug}.mp3")

        raw = open(md_path, encoding="utf-8").read()
        body = strip_front_matter(raw)
        text = strip_markdown(body)
        text = preprocess_programming_terms(text)  # MUST run before preprocess_numbers
        text = preprocess_numbers(text)

        if len(text.strip()) < 10:
            print(f"  Skipping (too short): {len(text)} chars")
            new_manifest[slug] = {"hash": content_hash}
            skipped += 1
            continue

        print(f"  Text: {len(text)} chars")

        start = time.time()
        if generate_audio(text, mp3_path, voice=args.voice, model_name=args.model):
            elapsed = time.time() - start
            print(f"  Done in {elapsed:.1f}s")
            new_manifest[slug] = {"hash": content_hash}
            generated += 1
        else:
            print(f"  FAILED: {slug}")
            failed += 1

    # Save updated manifest
    save_manifest(args.output_dir, new_manifest)

    print(f"\nAudio generation complete: {generated} generated, {skipped} skipped, {failed} failed")

    if failed > 0:
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

FILE: tools/ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor/Books/BookCompiler.cs

using YamlDotNet.Core;

namespace ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor.Books;

public sealed class BookCompiler(
    IReadOnlyDictionary<string, AuthorProfile> authors,
    DateTime publishBefore,
    BuildDiagnostics diagnostics,
    TextWriter log)
{
    public const string BookManifestFile = "book.yml";
    public const string ChapterManifestFile = "chapter.yml";

    private string _root = "";

    public IReadOnlyList<CompiledBook> Compile(string booksDir)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(booksDir))
        {
            log.WriteLine($"Books directory '{booksDir}' does not exist. No books processed.");
            return [];
        }

        _root = booksDir;
        var books = new List<CompiledBook>();

        foreach (var bookDir in Directory.GetDirectories(booksDir).Where(d => !ContentNaming.IsHidden(d)).Order(StringComparer.Ordinal))
        {
            var book = CompileBook(bookDir);
            if (book is not null)
            {
                books.Add(book);
            }
        }

        return books
            .OrderByDescending(b => b.Index.Date)
            .ThenBy(b => b.Index.Slug, StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .ToArray();
    }

    private CompiledBook? CompileBook(string bookDir)
    {
        var slug = Path.GetFileName(bookDir);
        var location = Relative(bookDir);
        log.WriteLine($"Processing book: {slug}");

        if (!ContentNaming.IsValidSlug(slug))
        {
            diagnostics.Error(location, "book folder name must contain only lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens");
            return null;
        }

        var manifest = ReadYaml<BookManifest>(Path.Combine(bookDir, BookManifestFile));
        if (manifest is null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(manifest.Title))
        {
            diagnostics.Error(Relative(Path.Combine(bookDir, BookManifestFile)), "title is required");
            return null;
        }

        if (manifest.Draft)
        {
            log.WriteLine($"  SKIPPED: Draft book '{manifest.Title}'");
            return null;
        }

        if (manifest.Date > publishBefore)
        {
            log.WriteLine($"  SKIPPED: Future book '{manifest.Title}' (date: {manifest.Date:yyyy-MM-dd})");
            return null;
        }

        var documents = new List<SubchapterDocument>();
        var chapters = CompileChapters(bookDir, slug, documents);

        if (chapters.Count == 0)
        {
            diagnostics.Warning(location, "book has no published chapters and was skipped");
            return null;
        }

        var authorId = manifest.Author ?? "";
        var authorName = ResolveAuthorName(authorId, location);
        var tags = manifest.Tags ?? [];
        var summary = manifest.Summary ?? "";

        var toc = new BookToc
        {
            Slug = slug,
            Title = manifest.Title,
            Date = manifest.Date,
            Updated = manifest.Updated,
            Author = authorId,
            AuthorName = authorName,
            Summary = summary,
            Tags = tags,
            Image = manifest.Image,
            Chapters = chapters
        };

        var index = new BookIndexEntry
        {
            Slug = slug,
            Title = manifest.Title,
            Date = manifest.Date,
            Updated = manifest.Updated,
            Author = authorId,
            AuthorName = authorName,
            Summary = summary,
            Tags = tags,
            Image = manifest.Image,
            ChapterCount = chapters.Count,
            SubchapterCount = documents.Count,
            QuestionCount = documents.Sum(d => d.Questions.Count),
            ReadingTimeMinutes = documents.Sum(d => d.ReadingTimeMinutes)
        };

        log.WriteLine($"  {chapters.Count} chapter(s), {index.SubchapterCount} subchapter(s), {index.QuestionCount} question(s)");
        return new CompiledBook(index, toc, documents);
    }

    private List<ChapterToc> CompileChapters(string bookDir, string bookSlug, List<SubchapterDocument> documents)
    {
        var chapters = new List<ChapterToc>();
        HashSet<string> seenSlugs = [with(StringComparer.Ordinal)];

        foreach (var entry in ReadNumberedEntries(Directory.GetDirectories(bookDir), p => Path.GetFileName(p)))
        {
            var location = Relative(entry.Path);

            if (!seenSlugs.Add(entry.Slug))
            {
                diagnostics.Error(location, $"duplicate chapter slug '{entry.Slug}'");
                continue;
            }

            var manifest = ReadYaml<ChapterManifest>(Path.Combine(entry.Path, ChapterManifestFile));
            if (manifest is null)
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(manifest.Title))
            {
                diagnostics.Error(Relative(Path.Combine(entry.Path, ChapterManifestFile)), "title is required");
                continue;
            }

            if (manifest.Draft)
            {
                log.WriteLine($"  SKIPPED: Draft chapter '{manifest.Title}'");
                continue;
            }

            var chapterNumber = chapters.Count + 1;
            var subchapters = CompileSubchapters(entry.Path, bookSlug, entry.Slug, chapterNumber, documents);

            if (subchapters.Count == 0)
            {
                diagnostics.Warning(location, "chapter has no published subchapters and was skipped");
                continue;
            }

            chapters.Add(new ChapterToc
            {
                Number = chapterNumber,
                Slug = entry.Slug,
                Title = manifest.Title,
                Summary = manifest.Summary ?? "",
                Subchapters = subchapters
            });
        }

        return chapters;
    }

    private List<SubchapterToc> CompileSubchapters(
        string chapterDir,
        string bookSlug,
        string chapterSlug,
        int chapterNumber,
        List<SubchapterDocument> documents)
    {
        var subchapters = new List<SubchapterToc>();
        HashSet<string> seenSlugs = [with(StringComparer.Ordinal)];

        foreach (var entry in ReadNumberedEntries(Directory.GetFiles(chapterDir, "*.md"), p => Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(p)))
        {
            var location = Relative(entry.Path);

            if (!seenSlugs.Add(entry.Slug))
            {
                diagnostics.Error(location, $"duplicate subchapter slug '{entry.Slug}'");
                continue;
            }

            var parsed = ParseSubchapter(entry.Path, location);
            if (parsed is null)
            {
                continue;
            }

            var (frontMatter, body) = parsed.Value;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(frontMatter.Title))
            {
                diagnostics.Error(location, "title is required");
                continue;
            }

            if (frontMatter.Draft)
            {
                log.WriteLine($"  SKIPPED: Draft subchapter '{frontMatter.Title}'");
                continue;
            }

            var questions = QuestionCompiler.Compile(frontMatter.Questions, location, diagnostics);
            var number = subchapters.Count + 1;
            var readingTime = FrontMatterParser.CalculateReadingTime(body);

            documents.Add(new SubchapterDocument
            {
                BookSlug = bookSlug,
                ChapterSlug = chapterSlug,
                Slug = entry.Slug,
                ChapterNumber = chapterNumber,
                Number = number,
                Title = frontMatter.Title,
                ReadingTimeMinutes = readingTime,
                Html = MarkdownProcessor.ToHtml(body),
                Questions = questions
            });

            subchapters.Add(new SubchapterToc
            {
                Number = number,
                Slug = entry.Slug,
                Title = frontMatter.Title,
                ReadingTimeMinutes = readingTime,
                QuestionIds = questions.Select(q => q.Id).ToArray()
            });
        }

        return subchapters;
    }

    private IEnumerable<NumberedEntry> ReadNumberedEntries(IEnumerable<string> paths, Func<string, string> nameSelector)
    {
        var entries = new List<NumberedEntry>();

        foreach (var path in paths.Where(p => !ContentNaming.IsHidden(p)))
        {
            var name = nameSelector(path);
            if (ContentNaming.TryParseNumbered(name, out var order, out var slug))
            {
                entries.Add(new NumberedEntry(order, slug, path));
            }
            else
            {
                diagnostics.Error(Relative(path), "name must look like '01-my-slug' (number, hyphen, lowercase slug)");
            }
        }

        return entries
            .OrderBy(e => e.Order)
            .ThenBy(e => e.Path, StringComparer.Ordinal);
    }

    private (SubchapterFrontMatter FrontMatter, string MarkdownBody)? ParseSubchapter(string path, string location)
    {
        try
        {
            return FrontMatterParser.Parse<SubchapterFrontMatter>(File.ReadAllText(path));
        }
        catch (YamlException ex)
        {
            diagnostics.Error(location, $"invalid front matter: {ex.Message}");
            return null;
        }
    }

    private T? ReadYaml<T>(string path) where T : class, new()
    {
        var location = Relative(path);

        if (!File.Exists(path))
        {
            diagnostics.Error(location, "file is missing");
            return null;
        }

        try
        {
            return FrontMatterParser.DeserializeYaml<T>(File.ReadAllText(path));
        }
        catch (YamlException ex)
        {
            diagnostics.Error(location, $"invalid YAML: {ex.Message}");
            return null;
        }
    }

    private string ResolveAuthorName(string authorId, string location)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(authorId))
        {
            return "";
        }

        if (authors.TryGetValue(authorId, out var profile))
        {
            return profile.Name;
        }

        diagnostics.Warning(location, $"no author profile found for '{authorId}'");
        return authorId;
    }

    private string Relative(string path) =>
        string.IsNullOrEmpty(_root) ? path : Path.GetRelativePath(_root, path).Replace('\\', '/');

    private sealed record NumberedEntry(int Order, string Slug, string Path);
}

using System.Text.Json;

namespace ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor.Books;

public static class BookOutputWriter
{
    public const string DataDirectoryName = "book-data";
    public const string IndexFileName = "books-index.json";
    public const string TocFileName = "toc.json";

    public static string Write(IReadOnlyList<CompiledBook> books, string outputDir, JsonSerializerOptions jsonOptions)
    {
        var root = Path.Combine(outputDir, DataDirectoryName);
        if (Directory.Exists(root))
        {
            Directory.Delete(root, recursive: true);
        }
        Directory.CreateDirectory(root);

        WriteJson(Path.Combine(root, IndexFileName), books.Select(b => b.Index).ToArray(), jsonOptions);

        foreach (var book in books)
        {
            var bookDir = Path.Combine(root, book.Toc.Slug);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(bookDir);
            WriteJson(Path.Combine(bookDir, TocFileName), book.Toc, jsonOptions);

            foreach (var document in book.Documents)
            {
                var chapterDir = Path.Combine(bookDir, document.ChapterSlug);
                Directory.CreateDirectory(chapterDir);
                WriteJson(Path.Combine(chapterDir, $"{document.Slug}.json"), document, jsonOptions);
            }
        }

        return root;
    }

    private static void WriteJson<T>(string path, T value, JsonSerializerOptions jsonOptions) =>
        File.WriteAllText(path, JsonSerializer.Serialize(value, jsonOptions));
}

FILE: tools/ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor/Books/ContentNaming.cs

using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor.Books;

public static partial class ContentNaming
{
    [GeneratedRegex(@"^(\d+)[-_]([a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*)$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant)]
    private static partial Regex NumberedPattern();

    [GeneratedRegex(@"^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant)]
    private static partial Regex SlugPattern();

    public static bool IsValidSlug(string? slug) =>
        !string.IsNullOrEmpty(slug) && SlugPattern().IsMatch(slug);

    public static bool TryParseNumbered(string name, out int order, out string slug)
    {
        order = 0;
        slug = "";

        var match = NumberedPattern().Match(name);
        if (!match.Success ||
            !int.TryParse(match.Groups[1].ValueSpan, NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out order))
        {
            return false;
        }

        slug = match.Groups[2].Value;
        return true;
    }

    public static bool IsHidden(string path)
    {
        var name = Path.GetFileName(path.TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar));
        return name.StartsWith('.') || name.StartsWith('_');
    }
}

FILE: tools/ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor/Books/QuestionCompiler.cs

namespace ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor.Books;

public static class QuestionCompiler
{
    public const string SingleType = "single";
    public const string MultipleType = "multiple";
    private const int MinimumOptions = 2;

    public static IReadOnlyList<QuestionDocument> Compile(
        IReadOnlyList<QuestionDefinition>? definitions,
        string location,
        BuildDiagnostics diagnostics)
    {
        if (definitions is null || definitions.Count == 0)
        {
            return [];
        }

        List<QuestionDocument> questions = [with(capacity: definitions.Count)];
        HashSet<string> seenIds = [with(StringComparer.Ordinal)];

        for (var i = 0; i < definitions.Count; i++)
        {
            var definition = definitions[i];
            var id = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(definition.Id) ? $"q{i + 1}" : definition.Id.Trim();
            var questionLocation = $"{location} question '{id}'";

            if (!ContentNaming.IsValidSlug(id))
            {
                diagnostics.Error(questionLocation, "id must contain only lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens");
                continue;
            }

            if (!seenIds.Add(id))
            {
                diagnostics.Error(questionLocation, "duplicate question id");
                continue;
            }

            var question = CompileQuestion(definition, id, questionLocation, diagnostics);
            if (question is not null)
            {
                questions.Add(question);
            }
        }

        return questions;
    }

    private static QuestionDocument? CompileQuestion(
        QuestionDefinition definition,
        string id,
        string location,
        BuildDiagnostics diagnostics)
    {
        var errorCount = diagnostics.Errors.Count;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(definition.Prompt))
        {
            diagnostics.Error(location, "prompt is required");
        }

        var options = CompileOptions(definition.Options ?? [], location, diagnostics);
        var correctCount = options.Count(o => o.Correct);

        if (options.Count < MinimumOptions)
        {
            diagnostics.Error(location, $"at least {MinimumOptions} options are required");
        }

        if (correctCount == 0)
        {
            diagnostics.Error(location, "at least one option must be marked correct");
        }

        var multipleAnswers = ResolveMultipleAnswers(definition.Type, correctCount, location, diagnostics);

        if (diagnostics.Errors.Count > errorCount)
        {
            return null;
        }

        return new QuestionDocument
        {
            Id = id,
            PromptHtml = MarkdownProcessor.ToHtml(definition.Prompt.Trim()),
            MultipleAnswers = multipleAnswers,
            ExplanationHtml = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(definition.Explanation)
                ? ""
                : MarkdownProcessor.ToHtml(definition.Explanation.Trim()),
            Options = options
        };
    }

    private static List<OptionDocument> CompileOptions(
        IReadOnlyList<OptionDefinition> definitions,
        string location,
        BuildDiagnostics diagnostics)
    {
        List<OptionDocument> options = [with(capacity: definitions.Count)];
        HashSet<string> seenIds = [with(StringComparer.Ordinal)];

        for (var i = 0; i < definitions.Count; i++)
        {
            var definition = definitions[i];
            var id = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(definition.Id) ? DefaultOptionId(i) : definition.Id.Trim();

            if (!ContentNaming.IsValidSlug(id))
            {
                diagnostics.Error(location, $"option id '{id}' must contain only lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens");
                continue;
            }

            if (!seenIds.Add(id))
            {
                diagnostics.Error(location, $"duplicate option id '{id}'");
                continue;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(definition.Text))
            {
                diagnostics.Error(location, $"option '{id}' has no text");
                continue;
            }

            options.Add(new OptionDocument
            {
                Id = id,
                TextHtml = MarkdownProcessor.ToInlineHtml(definition.Text.Trim()),
                Correct = definition.Correct
            });
        }

        return options;
    }

    private static bool ResolveMultipleAnswers(
        string? type,
        int correctCount,
        string location,
        BuildDiagnostics diagnostics)
    {
        var normalized = type?.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
        switch (normalized)
        {
            case null or "":
                return correctCount > 1;
            case MultipleType:
                return true;
            case SingleType:
                if (correctCount > 1)
                {
                    diagnostics.Error(location, "type is 'single' but more than one option is marked correct");
                }
                return false;
            default:
                diagnostics.Error(location, $"unknown type '{type}' (expected '{SingleType}' or '{MultipleType}')");
                return false;
        }
    }

    public static string DefaultOptionId(int index) =>
        index < 26 ? ((char)('a' + index)).ToString() : $"o{index + 1}";
}

FILE: tools/ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor/FrontMatterParser.cs

using YamlDotNet.Serialization;
using YamlDotNet.Serialization.NamingConventions;

namespace ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor;

public static class FrontMatterParser
{
    private const string Delimiter = "---";
    private const string ClosingDelimiter = "\n---";

    private static readonly IDeserializer Deserializer = new DeserializerBuilder()
        .WithNamingConvention(CamelCaseNamingConvention.Instance)
        .IgnoreUnmatchedProperties()
        .Build();

    public static (FrontMatter FrontMatter, string MarkdownBody) Parse(string rawContent) =>
        Parse<FrontMatter>(rawContent);

    public static (T FrontMatter, string MarkdownBody) Parse<T>(string rawContent) where T : new()
    {
        if (!rawContent.StartsWith(Delimiter, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            return (new T(), rawContent);
        }

        var endIndex = rawContent.IndexOf(ClosingDelimiter, Delimiter.Length, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        if (endIndex < 0)
        {
            return (new T(), rawContent);
        }

        var yamlBlock = rawContent[Delimiter.Length..endIndex].Trim();
        var body = rawContent[(endIndex + ClosingDelimiter.Length)..].TrimStart('\r', '\n');

        return (DeserializeYaml<T>(yamlBlock), body);
    }

    public static T DeserializeYaml<T>(string yaml) where T : new() =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(yaml) ? new T() : Deserializer.Deserialize<T>(yaml) ?? new T();

    public static AuthorProfile? ParseAuthor(string yamlContent, string id)
    {
        try
        {
            var profile = Deserializer.Deserialize<AuthorProfile>(yamlContent);
            profile.Id = id;
            return profile;
        }
        catch
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static string DeriveSlug(string fileName)
    {
        if (fileName.Length > 11 &&
            char.IsDigit(fileName[0]) &&
            fileName[4] == '-' &&
            fileName[7] == '-' &&
            fileName[10] == '-')
        {
            return fileName[11..];
        }
        return fileName;
    }

    public static int CalculateReadingTime(string markdownBody)
    {
        var wordCount = markdownBody
            .Split([' ', '\n', '\r', '\t'], StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
            .Length;
        return Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Ceiling(wordCount / 200.0));
    }
}

public sealed class FrontMatter
{
    public string Title { get; init; } = "";
    public DateTime Date { get; init; }
    public DateTime? Updated { get; init; }
    public string? Author { get; init; }
    public string? Summary { get; init; }
    public string[]? Tags { get; init; }
    public bool Draft { get; init; }
    public bool Featured { get; init; }
    public string? Series { get; init; }
    public string? Image { get; init; }
}

public sealed class AuthorProfile
{
    public string Id { get; set; } = "";
    public string Name { get; init; } = "";
    public string? Email { get; init; }
    public string? Bio { get; init; }
    public string? Avatar { get; init; }
    public Dictionary<string, string>? Socials { get; init; }
}

FILE: tools/ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor/MarkdownProcessor.cs

using Markdig;

namespace ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor;

public static class MarkdownProcessor
{
    private const string ParagraphOpen = "<p>";
    private const string ParagraphClose = "</p>";

    private static readonly MarkdownPipeline Pipeline = new MarkdownPipelineBuilder()
        .UseAdvancedExtensions()
        .Use<SyntaxHighlightingExtension>()
        .Build();

    public static string ToHtml(string markdown) => Markdown.ToHtml(markdown, Pipeline);

    public static string ToInlineHtml(string markdown)
    {
        var html = ToHtml(markdown).Trim();
        var isSingleParagraph =
            html.StartsWith(ParagraphOpen, StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
            html.EndsWith(ParagraphClose, StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
            html.IndexOf(ParagraphOpen, ParagraphOpen.Length, StringComparison.Ordinal) < 0;

        return isSingleParagraph
            ? html[ParagraphOpen.Length..^ParagraphClose.Length]
            : html;
    }
}

FILE: tools/ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor/Program.cs

using System.Text.Json;
using ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor;
using ObserverMagazine.ContentProcessor.Books;

string contentDir = "content/blog";
string outputDir = "src/ObserverMagazine.Web/wwwroot";
string authorsDir = "content/authors";
string booksDir = "content/books";
DateTime publishBefore = DateTime.UtcNow;

for (int i = 0; i < args.Length; i++)
{
    if (args[i] == "--content-dir" && i + 1 < args.Length)
        contentDir = args[++i];
    else if (args[i] == "--output-dir" && i + 1 < args.Length)
        outputDir = args[++i];
    else if (args[i] == "--authors-dir" && i + 1 < args.Length)
        authorsDir = args[++i];
    else if (args[i] == "--books-dir" && i + 1 < args.Length)
        booksDir = args[++i];
    else if (args[i] == "--publish-before" && i + 1 < args.Length)
        publishBefore = DateTime.Parse(args[++i]);
}

Console.WriteLine($"Content directory: {contentDir}");
Console.WriteLine($"Output directory:  {outputDir}");
Console.WriteLine($"Authors directory: {authorsDir}");
Console.WriteLine($"Books directory:   {booksDir}");
Console.WriteLine($"Publish before:    {publishBefore:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} UTC");

Dictionary<string, AuthorProfile> authorProfiles = [with(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)];

if (Directory.Exists(authorsDir))
{
    var authorFiles = Directory.GetFiles(authorsDir, "*.yml", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly);
    Console.WriteLine($"Found {authorFiles.Length} author profile(s)");

    foreach (var authorFile in authorFiles)
    {
        var authorId = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(authorFile);
        var yamlContent = File.ReadAllText(authorFile);
        var profile = FrontMatterParser.ParseAuthor(yamlContent, authorId);

        if (profile is not null)
        {
            authorProfiles[authorId] = profile;
            Console.WriteLine($"  Loaded author: {authorId} ({profile.Name})");
        }
        else
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"  WARNING: Could not parse author file {authorFile}");
        }
    }
}
else
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Authors directory '{authorsDir}' does not exist. No author profiles loaded.");
}

string blogDataDir = Path.Combine(outputDir, "blog-data");
Directory.CreateDirectory(blogDataDir);

var jsonOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions
{
    PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase,
    WriteIndented = true
};

var authorsPath = Path.Combine(blogDataDir, "authors.json");
var authorsJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(authorProfiles.Values.ToArray(), jsonOptions);
File.WriteAllText(authorsPath, authorsJson);
Console.WriteLine($"Wrote authors index: {authorsPath} ({authorProfiles.Count} authors)");

if (!Directory.Exists(contentDir))
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Content directory '{contentDir}' does not exist. Creating with no posts.");
    Directory.CreateDirectory(contentDir);
}

var markdownFiles = Directory.GetFiles(contentDir, "*.md", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly);
Console.WriteLine($"Found {markdownFiles.Length} markdown files");

List<PostIndexEntry> allPostMetadata = [];
Dictionary<string, string> postHtmlMap = [];
int skippedDrafts = 0;
int skippedFuture = 0;

foreach (var mdFile in markdownFiles)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Processing: {Path.GetFileName(mdFile)}");

    var rawContent = File.ReadAllText(mdFile);
    var (frontMatter, markdownBody) = FrontMatterParser.Parse(rawContent);

    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(frontMatter.Title))
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"  WARNING: No title in front matter, skipping {mdFile}");
        continue;
    }

    if (frontMatter.Draft)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"  SKIPPED: Draft post '{frontMatter.Title}'");
        skippedDrafts++;
        continue;
    }

    if (frontMatter.Date > publishBefore)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"  SKIPPED: Future post '{frontMatter.Title}' (date: {frontMatter.Date:yyyy-MM-dd}, publish-before: {publishBefore:yyyy-MM-dd})");
        skippedFuture++;
        continue;
    }

    var fileName = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(mdFile);
    var slug = FrontMatterParser.DeriveSlug(fileName);

    var html = MarkdownProcessor.ToHtml(markdownBody);
    var readingTime = FrontMatterParser.CalculateReadingTime(markdownBody);

    var authorId = frontMatter.Author ?? "";
    var authorName = authorId;
    string? authorEmail = null;
    if (authorProfiles.TryGetValue(authorId, out var authorProfile))
    {
        authorName = authorProfile.Name;
        authorEmail = authorProfile.Email;
    }
    else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(authorId))
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"  WARNING: No author profile found for '{authorId}'");
    }

    var htmlPath = Path.Combine(blogDataDir, $"{slug}.html");
    File.WriteAllText(htmlPath, html);
    Console.WriteLine($"  Wrote: {htmlPath} (~{readingTime} min read)");

    postHtmlMap[slug] = html;

    allPostMetadata.Add(new PostIndexEntry
    {
        Slug = slug,
        Title = frontMatter.Title,
        Date = frontMatter.Date,
        Updated = frontMatter.Updated,
        Author = authorId,
        AuthorName = authorName,
        AuthorEmail = authorEmail,
        Summary = frontMatter.Summary ?? "",
        Tags = frontMatter.Tags ?? [],
        Featured = frontMatter.Featured,
        Series = frontMatter.Series,
        Image = frontMatter.Image,
        ReadingTimeMinutes = readingTime
    });
}

allPostMetadata.Sort((a, b) => b.Date.CompareTo(a.Date));

var indexPath = Path.Combine(blogDataDir, "posts-index.json");
var indexJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(allPostMetadata, jsonOptions);
File.WriteAllText(indexPath, indexJson);
Console.WriteLine($"Wrote posts index: {indexPath} ({allPostMetadata.Count} posts, {skippedDrafts} drafts skipped, {skippedFuture} future posts skipped)");

var feedPath = Path.Combine(outputDir, "feed.xml");
var rssXml = RssGenerator.Generate(
    title: "Terlingua Magazine",
    description: "A free, open-source Blazor WebAssembly showcase on .NET 11",
    siteUrl: "https://terlingua.github.io",
    posts: allPostMetadata,
    getPostHtml: slug => postHtmlMap.GetValueOrDefault(slug)
);
File.WriteAllText(feedPath, rssXml);
Console.WriteLine($"Wrote RSS feed: {feedPath}");

var bookDiagnostics = new BuildDiagnostics();
var books = new BookCompiler(authorProfiles, publishBefore, bookDiagnostics, Console.Out).Compile(booksDir);

foreach (var warning in bookDiagnostics.Warnings)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"  WARNING: {warning}");
}

if (bookDiagnostics.HasErrors)
{
    foreach (var error in bookDiagnostics.Errors)
    {
        Console.Error.WriteLine($"  ERROR: {error}");
    }
    Console.Error.WriteLine($"Book processing failed with {bookDiagnostics.Errors.Count} error(s).");
    return 1;
}

var bookDataDir = BookOutputWriter.Write(books, outputDir, jsonOptions);
Console.WriteLine($"Wrote book data: {bookDataDir} ({books.Count} books)");

Console.WriteLine("Content processing complete.");
return 0;

public sealed class PostIndexEntry
{
    public string Slug { get; init; } = "";
    public string Title { get; init; } = "";
    public DateTime Date { get; init; }
    public DateTime? Updated { get; init; }
    public string Author { get; init; } = "";
    public string AuthorName { get; init; } = "";
    public string? AuthorEmail { get; init; }
    public string Summary { get; init; } = "";
    public string[] Tags { get; init; } = [];
    public bool Featured { get; init; }
    public string? Series { get; init; }
    public string? Image { get; init; }
    public int ReadingTimeMinutes { get; init; }
}
